zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITCOMMAND_PLUNDER_TRADE_ROUTE_REQU: 该单元格上的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线属于一位您没与其交战的玩家。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITCOMMAND_WONDER_PRODUCTION_DESCRI: 为奇观添加 [ICON_Production] 生产力。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITFLAG_LEVY_ACTIVE: 从{1_PlayerName}获得的雇佣兵（剩余 {2_TurnsRemaining} [ICON_Turn] {2_TurnsRemaining : plural 1?回合; other?回合;}）
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITOPERATIONS_CANNOT_REPAIR_RESOURC: 需要{1_Resource}资源才能进行修复
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITOPERATION_CANNOT_DESIGNATE_PARK: 必须位于适合建造国家公园的单元格上。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITOPERATION_CANNOT_HEAL_OUTSIDE_FR: 无法在友军领土之外恢复
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITOPERATION_FOUND_RELIGION_INVALID: 必须在您的圣地或巨石阵奇观上。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITOPERATION_FOUND_RELIGION_REQUIRE: 必须先建立一座万神殿。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITOPERATION_NEED_HOME_MUSEUM: {1_ArtifactName}必须归还给位于{2_CityName}的祖国博物馆。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITOPERATION_UPGRADE_REQUIRES_RESOU: 您的文明需要{2_AmountNeeded}{1_ResourceName}来提升这种单位类型。
没有足够的{1_Resource}补给。每种尚存或在生产中的单位使用1补给，任何城市每种自身拥有的和进口的资源提供4补给。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITOPERATION_WMD_STRIKE_DESCRIPTION: 大规模杀伤性武器攻击
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNITPANEL_ESPIONAGE_MORE_TURNS: 还有{1_RemainingTurns} {1_RemainingTurns : plural 1?回合; other?回合;}
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_AIRCRAFT_CARRIER_DESCRIPTION: 原子能时代的近战海军单位可运输空中单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_AMERICAN_P51_DESCRIPTION: 原子能时代的美国特色空中单位，取代战斗机。对阵战斗机时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力、飞行范围+2、所获经验值+50%。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_AMERICAN_ROUGH_RIDER_DESCRIPTIO: 泰迪·罗斯福作为领袖时的工业时代美国特色单位。在 [ICON_Capital] 首都所处大陆击杀敌人后可获得 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。在丘陵作战时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。维护费较低。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_ANTIAIR_GUN_DESCRIPTION: 原子能时代的防空支援单位。为一个格位以内的单位提供庇护以躲避空袭。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_APOSTLE_DESCRIPTION: 能让 [ICON_Citizen] 公民皈依其所属的宗教，可对其他宗教的单位发动神学战争。每场游戏中可发起1次宗教审讯，购买审判官。每场游戏中可进行1次传道信仰，为其宗教额外增加1个信仰。这些行动均会消耗使徒的使用次数。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_ARABIAN_MAMLUK_DESCRIPTION: 取代骑士的阿拉伯中世纪特色单位。在每回合结束时（甚至是在移动或攻击后），自动恢复生命值。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_ARCHAEOLOGIST_DESCRIPTION: 从 [ICON_RESOURCE_ANTIQUITY_SITE] 历史古迹发现和挖掘 [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物，并在其所属城市博物馆进行展出。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_ARCHER_DESCRIPTION: 第一个 [ICON_Range] 攻击范围是2的远古时代远程单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_ARTILLERY_DESCRIPTION: 现代攻城单位，适合对城市发起攻击。无法在一回合内移动并攻击（除非已获得“专家组”升级）。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_AZTEC_EAGLE_WARRIOR_DESCRIPTION: 取代勇士的阿兹特克远古时代特色单位。有几率把其他文明的军事单位转化为建造者并俘获。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_BARBARIAN_HORSEMAN_DESCRIPTION: 远古时代原始骑马勇士。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_BATTERING_RAM_DESCRIPTION: 远古时代支援单位。当邻近城市时，可使近战单位对城墙造成全额伤害。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_BATTLESHIP_DESCRIPTION: 现代海军远程单位。为一个格位以内的单位提供庇护以躲避空袭和核攻击。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_BIPLANE_DESCRIPTION: 最早的空战单位，现代可用。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_BOMBARD_DESCRIPTION: 文艺复兴时代攻城单位，适合对城市发起攻击。无法在一回合内移动并攻击（除非已获得“专家组”升级）。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_BOMBER_DESCRIPTION: 最早的轰炸单位，原子能时代可用。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_BRAZILIAN_MINAS_GERAES_DESCRIPT: 工业时代的巴西特色单位，取代战舰，强于战舰。通过“民族主义”解锁。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_BUILDER_DESCRIPTION: 可建造单元格改良设施、移除地貌（如森林或雨林），或收获资源。建造者可使用3次。可通过政策或奇观（如金字塔）增加使用次数。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_CAPTURED: 让这样一个无缚鸡之力的单位处于未受保护的状态很不明智。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]您的单位已被{1_Civ}俘获。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_CARAVEL_DESCRIPTION: 文艺复兴时期快速的探索近战海军单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_CATAPULT_DESCRIPTION: 古典时代攻城单位，适合对城市发起攻击。无法在一回合内移动并攻击（除非已获得“专家组”升级）。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_CAVALRY_DESCRIPTION: 能够快速移动的工业时代轻骑兵单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_CHINESE_CROUCHING_TIGER_DESCRIP: 中国中世纪特色单位。 [ICON_Range] 射程为1的高战斗力远程单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_DESTROYER_DESCRIPTION: 最强大的近战海军单位。显示视线范围内的海军袭击者。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_EGYPTIAN_CHARIOT_ARCHER_DESCRIP: 埃及远古时代特色单位，取代重型战车。从开阔地形开始时， [ICON_Movement] 移动力为4。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_ENGLISH_REDCOAT_DESCRIPTION: 维多利亚作为领袖时的工业时代英国特色单位，替代战列步兵。在非首都所处大陆作战时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。下船不消耗移动力。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_ENGLISH_SEADOG_DESCRIPTION: 文艺复兴时代英国特色海军单位，取代私掠船。击败敌方船只后有几率将其俘获。除非与单位相邻，否则只能被其他海军袭击者发现。能使视线范围中的海军袭击者暴露位置。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_FIGHTER_DESCRIPTION: 原子能时代双翼机升级。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_FRENCH_GARDE_IMPERIALE_DESCRIPT: 工业时代法国特色近战单位，替代战列步兵。在首都所处大陆作战时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。击杀单位后将获得 [ICON_GreatGeneral] 大将军点数。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_FRIGATE_DESCRIPTION: 文艺复兴时期的远程海军单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GALLEY_DESCRIPTION: 远古时代近战海军战斗单位。在研究出制图学之前，只能用于沿海水域。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GERMAN_UBOAT_DESCRIPTION: 取代潜艇的德国特色现代海军单位。生产成本更低，+1视野，在海洋单元格作战时，+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。能发现其他隐形单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ADMIRAL_DESCRIPTION: 每个 [ICON_GreatAdmiral] 海军统帅都有特色能力，包括被动效果和隐退效果。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ARTIST_DESCRIPTION: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家都能产生一个 [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] 艺术巨作。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ENGINEER_DESCRIPTION: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatEngineer] 大工程师都会拥有特色能力。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_GENERAL_DESCRIPTION: 每个 [ICON_GreatGeneral] 大将军都有特色能力，包括被动效果和隐退效果。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_MERCHANT_DESCRIPTION: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatMerchant] 大商人都会拥有特色能力。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_MUSICIAN_DESCRIPTION: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家都能产生一个 [ICON_GreatWork_Music] 音乐巨作。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_PROPHET_DESCRIPTION: 激活时，大 [ICON_GreatProphet] 预言家能创建一个宗教。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_SCIENTIST_DESCRIPTION: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatScientist] 大科学家都会拥有特色能力。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_WRITER_DESCRIPTION: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家都能产生一个 [ICON_GreatWork_Writing] 著作巨作。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GREEK_HOPLITE_DESCRIPTION: 远古时代希腊特色抗骑兵单位，替代枪兵。如与至少一个重装步兵相邻，则+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_GURU_DESCRIPTION: 消耗次数可治疗其自身以及相邻的全部友方宗教单位。无法发起和其他宗教单位的神学战争（但可进行防御）。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_HEAVY_CHARIOT_DESCRIPTION: 远古时代重骑兵单位，威力惊人。如果在一个没有树林、雨林和丘陵的平坦单元格上开始一个回合，会获得1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力加成。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_HELICOPTER_DESCRIPTION: 移动迅速的原子能时代轻骑兵单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_HORSEMAN_DESCRIPTION: 移动迅速的古典时代轻骑兵单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_INDIAN_VARU_DESCRIPTION: 古典时代的印度特色单位。与其相邻的敌方单位 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力-5。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_INQUISITOR_DESCRIPTION: 能清除他们领土上的其他宗教，并能对其他宗教单位发动神学战争。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_IRONCLAD_DESCRIPTION: 强大的工业时代装甲近战海军单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_JAPANESE_SAMURAI_DESCRIPTION: 中世纪日本特色近战单位，替代披甲战士。受伤后不会蒙受战斗力减益。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION: 中世纪重骑兵单位，威力惊人。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_KONGO_SHIELD_BEARER_DESCRIPTION: 取代剑客的刚果古典时代特色单位。防御远程攻击时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。能穿行以及视野能穿过树林和雨林。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_MEDIC_DESCRIPTION: 工业时代支援单位。能治疗邻近单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_MILITARY_ENGINEER_DESCRIPTION: 中世纪支援单位。需要“兵工厂”才能生产。能建造道路、堡垒、飞机跑道和导弹发射井改良设施。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_MISSILE_CRUISER_DESCRIPTION: 最强大的远程海军单位，信息时代可用。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_MISSIONARY_DESCRIPTION: 能让 [ICON_Citizen] 公民皈依所属宗教。无法对其他宗教单位发动神学战争（但可以进行防御）。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_MOBILE_SAM_DESCRIPTION: 信息时代的防空支援单位。为一个格位以内的单位提供庇护以躲避空袭和核攻击。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_MODERN_ARMOR_DESCRIPTION: 又快又强大的信息时代重骑兵单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_MODERN_AT_DESCRIPTION: 信息时代的抗骑兵类单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_MUSKETMAN_DESCRIPTION: 文艺复兴时期近战单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_NATURALIST_DESCRIPTION: 游戏后期平民单位，可以创建一座国家公园来吸引 [ICON_Tourism] 游客。 只能使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_NORWEGIAN_BERSERKER_DESCRIPTION: 中世纪挪威特色近战单位，替代披甲战士。若该单位从敌方领土开始回合，则拥有4点 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。进攻时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力，防御近战攻击时-5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_NORWEGIAN_LONGSHIP_DESCRIPTION: 取代桨帆船的挪威远古时代特色海军单位。通过海岸扫荡能力，可掠夺敌方海岸土地，并俘获附近的平民。能在中立领土上恢复。位于海岸水域时， [ICON_Movement] 移动力为4。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_NUCLEAR_SUBMARINE_DESCRIPTION: 高度发达的信息时代海军远程袭击单位，能配备核武器。除非与单位相邻，否则只能被其他海军袭击者发现。能使视线范围中的海军袭击者暴露位置。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_OBSERVATION_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION: 现代支援单位。为1单元格内的攻城类单位+1 [ICON_Range] 射程。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_PRIVATEER_DESCRIPTION: 文艺复兴时期的远程海军单位，能够进行海岸扫荡。除非与单位相邻，否则只能被其他海军袭击者发现。能使视线范围中的海军袭击者暴露位置。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_QUADRIREME_DESCRIPTION: 古典时期远程海军单位。在研究出制图学之前，只能用于沿海水域。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_RANGER_DESCRIPTION: 能够快速移动的工业时代侦察单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_ROCKET_ARTILLERY_DESCRIPTION: 信息时代攻城单位，适合对城市发起攻击。无法在一回合内移动并攻击（除非已获得“专家组”升级）。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_ROMAN_LEGION_DESCRIPTION: 取代剑客的罗马古典时代特色近战单位。能建造一个罗马堡垒。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_RUSSIAN_COSSACK_DESCRIPTION: 取代骑兵的俄罗斯工业时代特色单位。比骑兵更强大，位于或靠近俄罗斯领土作战时，+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。如有剩余 [ICON_Movement] 移动力，可在攻击后移动。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_SCOUT_DESCRIPTION: 能够快速移动的远古时代侦察单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_SCYTHIAN_HORSE_ARCHER_DESCRIPTI: 斯基泰古典时代特色单位。是 [ICON_Range] 射程为1， [ICON_Movement] 移动力为4的远程单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_SETTLER_DESCRIPTION: 可创建新城市。完成时，该城市 [ICON_Citizen] 人口减1。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_SIEGE_TOWER_DESCRIPTION: 古典时代支援单位。当靠近一座城市时，可让近战单位忽略城墙，直接攻击该城。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_SLINGER_DESCRIPTION: 薄弱的远古时代远程单位。攻强守弱。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_SPANISH_CONQUISTADOR_DESCRIPTIO: 文艺复兴时期西班牙特色单位，替代火枪手。与宗教单位处于同一单元格中时，+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。如果此单位占领城市、或在城市被占领时处于相邻单元格中，该城市会自动将该单位所属玩家的宗教采纳为主流宗教。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_SPY_DESCRIPTION: 可在国外城市执行秘密任务，或保护您的城市免遭敌方间谍骚扰。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_SUBMARINE_DESCRIPTION: 现代海军远程袭击单位。除非与单位相邻，否则只能被其他海军袭击者发现。能使视线范围中的海军袭击者暴露位置。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_SUMERIAN_WAR_CART_DESCRIPTION: 苏美尔远古时代特色单位。比其他所有初始单位更强大。对战抗骑兵单位时，无减益。如果该单位从开阔地形开始回合， [ICON_Movement] 移动力为4。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_SWORDSMAN_DESCRIPTION: 强大的古典时代近战单位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TANK_DESCRIPTION: 能够快速移动的现代重骑兵单位，它能忽略控制区。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRADER_DESCRIPTION: 能创建和维护一条 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线。随着旅途进行，自动创建道路。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_FULL_TRADE_ROUTE_CAPACITY: 您的文明需要更多 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_NEED_MILITARY_ACADEMY: 需要一个军事学院来立刻创建兵团和军队
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_NO_EMPTY_AIR_SLOTS: 该城市的飞机容量已满。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICTS_CONTAM: 训练此单位的区域均已受到污染。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICTS_DESTRO: 训练此单位的区域均已遭损坏。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICTS_OCCUPI: 用来训练该单位的区域均已被敌方单位占领。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICT_CONTAMI: 训练此单位的区域已受到污染。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICT_DESTROY: 训练此单位的区域已遭损坏。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICT_OCCUPIE: 用来训练该单位的区域已被一个敌方单位占领。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRES_POPULATION: 该城至少需要{1_PopulationNeeded} [ICON_Citizen] 人口。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRES_RESOURCE_ACCESS: 文明需要 {2_AmountNeededWithoutDistrict}点 {5_ResourceIcon} {1_ResourceName} 来训练这类单位。若该城市有 {4_DistrictName}，仅需{3_AmountNeededWithDistrict}点 {5_ResourceIcon} {1_ResourceName}。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRES_RESOURCE_SUPPLY: 没有足够的 {1_Resource} 补给。每种尚存或在生产中的单位使用1补给，任何城市每种自身拥有的和进口的资源提供4补给。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_TREBUCHET_DESCRIPTION: 中世纪攻城单位，适合对城市发起攻击。无法在一回合内移动并攻击（除非已获得“专家组”升级）。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_WARRIOR_DESCRIPTION: 薄弱的远古时代近战单位。

zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_CULTURE_TEXT: 文化的价值不是由它的成就来衡量，而是如何将这些成就延续下去，以及如何让它们被后人记住。您所描绘的美好蓝图激励了我们的人民开拓进取…也将确保我们的文明万古长青。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_CULTURE_TT: 您国家的伟大文化会将世界各地的人吸引到您的帝国。这是最难取得的胜利。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_DEFAULT_TEXT: 其他人都失败了…所以，您赢啦！
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_DOMINATION_TEXT: 尽管历史的变迁会改变它的容颜，但历史是由胜者的双手所著。以您今日所为，您必将带领人民走向辉煌的明天。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_DOMINATION_TT: 您通过军事力量和强大威力让世界臣服。这是最基础的胜利方式。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_RELIGION_TEXT: 我们的一个基本需求是相信比自己更伟大的事物。在黑暗中，我们渴望慰藉，渴望灯光照亮我们的道路。谢谢您，我们已在宇宙中找到了意义。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_RELIGIOUS_TT: 将您的宗教传播到世界各地，为黑暗的世界带来光明。如果希望全世界都皈依一种真正的宗教，您需要精于外交。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_SCIENCE_TEXT: 正如祖先在很多年前所做的那样，我们渴望了解未知世界。先驱已踏上艰险的旅程，我们的国民再一次茁壮成长。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_SCIENCE_TT: 成为第一个殖民火星的人，以此取得科技胜利。这种胜利非常直接，但是很难在时间耗尽前完成。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_SCORE_TEXT: 从多年前的渺小开始，您铸造的文明经受住了时间考验。虽然无数文明在我们眼前兴起、衰落，但我们幸存了下来。我们成功了。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_VICTORY_SCORE_TT: 如果无法获得巨大成功，那么您可以获得力所能及的胜利。当时间耗尽而无其他玩家用其他方式获胜即会触发。

en_US.ADVISOR_FTUE_47_ALT: Our Warriors stand before the village gates. They await your command to enter.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_2_ALT: It would seem we have finally tracked the Barbarian raiders plaguing these lands to their source. We must destroy this stronghold or risk future attacks.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_3_ALT: Still might I advise caution. Though primitive and savage, these Barbarians are fierce warriors and their camp is heavily defended.  To ensure victory we must attack with overwhelming force.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_4_ALT: Our city continues to prosper.  Already our people thrive and our population grows!
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_5_ALT: Although our scientists would be willing to explore other topics of research, perhaps it is not wise to  distract them from their current work unless absolutely necessary.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_6_ALT: The task at hand is of critical importance. Might I advise patience in this matter. We should allow our people to continue their work if at all possible.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_7_ALT: We have spotted another friendly village nearby. Perhaps we should send a Scout to investigate.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_7_ALT_2: We have spotted another friendly village nearby. Perhaps we should send a Scout to investigate.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_8_ALT2: A good city can become a great city through careful planning. Deciding where to place a city district is an important decision. Be sure to pick a location best suited for the district to reap the most benefit.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_10ALT: Victory! The Barbarians have learned we are not a people to be trifled with. Still, they will return, and next time I fear they will not take us so lightly.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_121: Excellent. The skills these Builders will attain will dramatically improve our civilization.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_12ALT: We should take advantage of this lull in hostilities. With our Warriors now prepared, we may focus our production capabilities towards the city itself.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_131: We have no more matters that require your attention today.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_13ALT: The lands surrounding our city are fertile. Yet as of now they lie undeveloped. We must create a workforce if we are to make the most of the resources within our borders.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_14_ALT: While our Builders train to improve life within our borders, we must not ignore the lands beyond them. The only way to truly master this world is to understand it.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_151: Alone, on foot, the wildlands take a heavy toll on our troops.  Perhaps there is a smoother path…
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_153: Already our Warriors' efforts bear fruit. They have come upon a small Tribal Village.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_154: This people seem different from the Barbarian tribes we encountered. Perhaps we should make contact instead of combat.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_155: We have attended to all matters necessary today.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_15ALT: Beyond combat, our Warriors make for ideal explorers in this uncertain and hostile world.  You need only give the word and they shall set forth into the unknown.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_16_ALT: It would seem friendship has its rewards. Our success against the Barbarians has reached this village. Impressed by our culture, they wish to rise up against their oppressors and join us in the fight against the horde.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_171: There may be other like-minded settlements in the lands ahead.  We would be wise to seek them out in the future...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_17_ALT: Though not skilled in the ways of combat, this tribe possess a great knowledge of the land. Their ability to move through the terrain quickly makes them ideal Scouts. We should put them to good use.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_181: No other matters require your attention today.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_18_ALT: We should employ these Scouts with caution. They are excellent explorers but poor warriors. It would be wise for them to avoid battle whenever possible.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_191: Our Builders now stand ready. Constructing a Farm on fertile lands within our city will increase our yield and better feed our people.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_192: These Plains possess rich soil. An ideal spot to plant our first crops...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_193: Excellent. With their stomachs full our people prosper and our population shall only grow...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_194: But remember, our Builders' strength is not infinite. We would be wise to make the best use of their talents before exhausting them.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_19_ALT: As our Scouts continue to push onwards let us turn inwards to our own Capital. As our city grows, so too does our people's hunger...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_1ALT_1: Welcome Cleopatra. Our people's fate lies in your hands. Great is the responsibility placed upon you. Perhaps I may be of service.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_1ALT_2: Welcome Gilgamesh. Our people's fate lies in your hands. Great is the responsibility placed upon you. Perhaps I may be of service.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_201: Excellent, as pride in their own culture grows our people shall be driven to spread our civilization beyond their own borders.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_202: And follow in the footsteps of our brave Scouts.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_204: Now that our people are fed, let us turn our Builder's attention elsewhere.  There are valuable resources surrounding our city that have yet to be exploited.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_205: Direct the efforts of our Builders towards harnessing these valuable materials.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_206: Excellent. This Stone we extract from this Quarry will only increase our production capabilities.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_207: It would appear some of our people still require your direction...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_209: With our Quarry now complete we must turn our Builders’ attention towards additional improvements.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_2091: There is still valuable land within our borders, we must guide their hands carefully.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_2092: Our people still await your command.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_20_ALT: With their basic needs met, our people now have the capability to construct more elaborate structures. Perhaps a Monument to all they have accomplished will inspire them to evolve even further...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_21_ALT: Exploration may bring many rewards, but let us not forget the safety of our Capital.  We should direct our Warriors home for its protection.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_22_ALT: Our Scouts await orders. They must explore and teach us about new lands yet undiscovered.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_22a: Our brave Settlers await your command. We should found our first city here.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_23: The lands before us offer untold riches and dangers.  You must consider that carefully when choosing their final destination.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_231: Our people are hard at work fulfilling your orders.  Let us take this time to further advance our Scouts.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_232: No other matters require your attention today.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_23_ALT: There are no further matters to attend to today.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_241: Our people delight in the pursuit of knowledge.  We need only direct their efforts and they shall uncover yet another mystery of this world.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_242: A wise decision. Our people may now uncover new uses for the materials we unearth in our Mines and Quarries.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_243: But let us not forget the exploration efforts of our Scouts.  There is a whole world before us to uncover.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_24_ALT: While our forces prepare the defense of our city, our best minds have discovered how to extract precious resources from the earth itself. With an abundance of valuable Stone nearby, our Builders may be able to exploit this knowledge when they complete their training.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_261: Excellent, with our Warriors entrenched in their positions our people are secure.  It would be wise to maintain this advantage for as long as possible.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_26_ALT: Our citizens rejoice at the return of our brave Warriors. Perhaps they should fortify their position to defend against the Barbarian threat.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_27_ALT: We are blessed. This Monument stands as symbol of the accomplishments and determination of our people.  Truly they shall now be inspired to push even further into the lands beyond.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_28_ALT: Perhaps we are now ready to spread our civilization beyond our Capital city. If we do not claim the surrounding territory, others surely will.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_292: There are reports of dangerous raiders roaming the lands nearby.  It would be best to keep these Warriors here, seeing to the safety of our Capital.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_29_ALT: Excellent, these brave Settlers are ready to carry our culture into the unknown. However, it will take some time before they are prepared for the journey that awaits them.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_2_ALT: For too long we have roamed this world without a land to call our own. It is time we put down roots.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_301: Excellent, with our people prepared we must now choose our destination.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_302: There is an area rich in resources not far from the Capital.  Let us send our Settlers there.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_30_ALT: Our Settlers have finished preparations and await your command. However, the lands before them possess untold dangers.  We must not allow them to go forth without protection...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_311: Though our Warriors are valiant a proper fighting force must be diversified.  Slingers provide a different style of combat.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_312: With knowledge comes opportunity. As our people's understanding of this world grows, new paths present themselves to us...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_31_ALT: Though our Settlers are safe under the protection of our Warriors, our Capital is now defenseless. Without the protection of the military we will most surely become overrun by our enemies.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_331: Order our people to take root here.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_332: Well done. Our civilization continues to spread beyond expectation.  In time it may rival even our own Capital.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_33_ALT: Location is critical in founding a new settlement.  We are fortunate to have  discovered such an ideal place.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_34_ALT: Already this new city yearns to grow.  Its people await your guidance.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_35_ALT: We have reports of another civilization growing on this continent. It seems we are not the only people competing for control of these lands.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_36: Though small now, our city will continue to grow if you allow it to.  Its fate and that of our people depend upon you.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_37a: We are fortunate that the land surrounding our city is rich in resources.  Developing it will be key to our survival...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_38: We are blessed to have such bountiful lands within our borders. Still, a civilization is comprised of people, not just earth.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_381: It appears our Slingers have completed their training. Already the people of our city feel safer...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_382: As our army continues to diversify and improve, our future grows even more secure.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_383: With our Slingers training complete, we may now direct our people's efforts to new pursuits.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_384: Our people still await your command.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_38_ALT: Our legacy will one day be recorded beyond the spoken word.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_391: By concentrating like minds and resources into districts we specialize the growth of our city. We must choose the location of these districts carefully in order to reap the most benefit.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_39_ALT: With Writing we unify our people.  A common written language allows ideas to flourish and our collective knowledge to grow. Were we to provide a place to collect and share this knowledge our people would surely prosper...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_3_ALTV2: From the seeds of this small city shall you grow an empire.  But to truly thrive we must first see to the needs of our people.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_401: But we must not allow these great thinkers to be idle.  Let us turn their attention elsewhere...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_40_ALT: Already the greatest minds in our civilization eagerly await the completion of this Campus...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_41_ALT: Our greatest scholars and scientists already begin to gather at our Campus. Providing them with a Library would further assist them in their pursuits.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_42_ALT: Resources and land are not infinite. It seems we now have competition.  As we do not yet know the true intention of this people, might I suggest we proceed with caution.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_43_ALT: War is upon us!  Our people are in danger.  We must mobilize an army immediately or risk being conquered.  There is no time for delay!
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_441: We must now enact policies to better steer the growth of our people...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_44_ALT: Our people truly thrive under your guidance. But as our civilization grows so too must our leadership.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_453: Though our policies begin to bear fruit our civilization will only continue to grow.  We must plan for the future...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_45_ALT: Discipline is the heart of any army and is a valuable advantage over the unorganized Barbarian rabble. Urban planning will only make our cities more organized and efficient. I suggest we enact both these policies.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_46_ALT: Such lands will surely draw the attention of the Barbarian raiders plaguing this area. We must prepare to fight back if we are to survive.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_48: Our people have looked to the heavens, and begun to wonder if our fortunes may be guided by the hands of a greater power. Who are these great gods, and what blessings might they bestow upon us?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_50_ALT: Your inspiration is contagious.  Though our civilization achieves greatness under your leadership, one amongst our people truly shines above all others. Under your guidance shall their impact truly reverberate throughout history.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_51_ALT: Isolation is not the key to prosperity. These traders allow us to reach out to our neighbors. Through trade, we stand to boost our economy, and gain new insights into the mysteries of the world.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_51a: If our people are to survive in these lands, we must focus their efforts. Only then can we master this world.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_52_ALT: We have made contact with people more advanced than the Tribal Villagers who have aided us in the past. Should we extend the hand of friendship or look to conquer them?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_61: Training has commenced. Already our people feel more secure.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_62: Our empire will not be built overnight. We have accomplished all we can this day...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_63: There are no other matters for you to attend to.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_6ALTV_1: Our people's protection is our utmost concern. Direct your city towards the creation of a Warrior.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_71: There are those among us with minds adept at unlocking the world's secrets. We need only guide them.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_7ALT: Our Warriors continue to train. But if we are to be more than the Barbarian tribes we defend against, we must explore other areas of development.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_81: There are no more matters requiring your attention today.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_8ALT: Excellent. As our people's understanding of the earth increases so too will our ability to harness its riches and increase our production capabilities. We must give them time to do their work.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_92: We cannot allow these savages to pillage and destroy all we have built. Our Warriors have completed their training. Let us commit them to battle!
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_94: Warriors are the blade with which we will strike down our enemy. They need only your hand to guide them.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_9ALT: Barbarian raiders approach our city!  We are surely too prize a target for them to ignore.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_END_SCRIPTED_2: The task before us is great, but under your leadership we shall not fail.  As always I stand ready at your side should you require any assistance along the way.  May our civilization truly stand forever.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_END_SCRIPTED_3: We are victorious! You are now ready to take on bigger challenges, explore new worlds, meet new civilizations, and to achieve victory on your own terms.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_END_SCRIPTED_ALT: Our people have prospered under your guidance.  Truly our civilization has no equal.  Perhaps now is the time for you to prove this to be true.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_POP_HUT_1: Again our brave Scouts prove their worth to our people.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_WONDER_73: The beauty and majesty of this world is sometimes enough to inspire our people to new directions of thought. This was a fortunate discovery...
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_1: Through exploration we have discovered a natural wonder of the world. There is no doubt that it could provide a great benefit to the one who settles the lands surrounding it.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_10: The combat achievements of this unit have become legendary, and worthy of a name unique to them. With what title shall we honor them?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_11: The health of this unit is very low and in danger of being lost. Allowing a unit to take a break from combat and rest will allow it to heal over time.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_12: It is best to use caution when moving close to enemy units. Doing so will often force the unit to be in the enemy's 'zone of control', restricting its movement.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_13: My liege, our city would do well with some farms or other improvements. I suggest we train a Builder soon.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_14: Our Builders have been idle. Perhaps we should direct their efforts to improving the lands around our city.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_15: Our capital flourishes! But I think it is time that we begin establishing roots elsewhere. Perhaps we should train a Settler.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_16: My liege, we have an Envoy at our disposal. We can use the Envoy to gain favor with a city-state. Becoming friendly with a city-state neighbor can be greatly beneficial to our civilization.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_17: Our City-State neighbors have made a request of us. If we can impress them, I think they will reward us handsomely.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_18: I'm afraid I must report that we are bankrupt. It is imperative that we do whatever we can to ease ourselves of this debt. May I suggest we disband some of our military?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_19: Your grace, I must warn you that some of the improved lands around our city have been pillaged. We should find those responsible and ensure no more damage can be done.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_2: Reconnaissance units like Scouts are unique in that they can gain experience by exploring and discovering parts of the world.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_20: We have recently gained advanced knowledge in city planning. Creating districts in our cities can be much more powerful and lucrative than simple improvements like Farms and Mines.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_21: Our military has learned the way of combining two military units into larger scale Corps. These Corps units are much more powerful than their singular counterparts.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_22: Our military now is trained in the way of combining three military units into a single Army, much larger and more powerful than a Corps unit.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_23: Your Grace, we have obtained greater knowledge in the art of building static fortifications. Building Walls around our cities will not only make them stronger against a foreign invader, but will also allow them to bombard nearby enemies.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_24: Your grace! The enemy is at our gates, and this city is surrounded and under siege. Supplies and food cannot get through, and our city cannot heal its wounds. It is paramount that we break this encirclement.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_25: An enemy is in range of our city. Order the city garrison to conduct a ranged attack against the invaders.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_26: It is important to keep a close eye on our neighbors, and our people may be able to help. Listen carefully, for they are sometimes privy to more information than we are.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_27: My liege, we are beginning to attract the attention of the Great People of the world. Of course, there are other leaders vying for their attention, too.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_28: The more specialized districts we construct, the more we will draw in specialized Great People to share their talents with our civilization. I advise that we continue to build these.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_29: A famous artist is inspired by our civilization, and has come to our lands to create great works of art. I suggest we find somewhere to house these masterpieces immediately.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_3: The workforce of our Builder unit has been expended. We will need to train more Builders to continue building improvements on the lands surrounding our cities.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_30: This writer has been inspired by our civilization, and comes to our lands to create great works of writing. I suggest we find somewhere to house these masterpieces immediately.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_31: Our populace has attracted a Great Prophet to our lands! Send this most holy person to our Holy Site and rejoice, for the time has come to found a religion for ourselves.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_32: This musician is inspired by our civilization, and has come to our land to create great musical works. I suggest we find somewhere to house these masterpieces immediately.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_33: Our civilization's attention to the naval arm of our military has given rise to a Great Admiral among our ranks. When deployed wisely among our ships we are sure to have a distinct advantage in battle.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_34: Our civilization's dedication to military affairs has given rise to a Great General among our troops. When used wisely in the field, generals can change the tide of battle in our favor.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_35: A great merchant has come to our civilization! Each one has a unique talent which will help our economy flourish.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_36: Our dedication to the ways of science has attracted a great scientist to our civilization! I am certain we will be able to use them to benefit future scientific developments.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_37: Constructing wonders of the world not only is a remarkable display of our empire's greatness, they have other benefits as well. Remember, other civilizations may also be competing in this endeavor, and there can only be one of each type in the world.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_38: Just as our citizens have faith in your leadership, so they are beginning to have faith in a higher power. I think it is wise to cultivate this new way of thinking - perhaps there is some benefit to be gained.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_39: The number of faithful has grown, and it is time for us to define our beliefs. Let us choose a pantheon to worship.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_4: Enacting new policies in our government can be of great benefit. Our people await your decree.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_40: My liege, we have the ability to train religious missionaries to begin spreading our great religion to foreign lands.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_41: Your majesty, I believe that we may benefit from recruiting an apostle to spread our religion. These holy people are quite powerful in the ways of conversion.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_42: All other religions in the world are a threat to our faith. We can recruit Inquisitors to purge the heretics from our cities.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_43: Your Excellency, I feel it is time to build some Neighborhoods for our growing populous. We should build these on our most beautiful lands - near natural wonders, or perhaps by the Coast.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_44: My liege, all of our military has been destroyed and we are completely defenseless. Training military units is of utmost importance if we are to survive.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_45: Our explorers have spotted another friendly Tribal Village. I suggest we send a Scout to investigate.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_46: Your Majesty, keep your allies close and your enemies closer. We are now able to recruit a Spy who could help us better understand what it is that our neighbors do… On a more covert level.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_5: The opportunity has arrived for a change into a new and more powerful system of government. Let us strengthen our identity and enact more policies to govern our people.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_50: Some resources, like this one, can be harvested. This will remove the resource in exchange for an immediate gain.  But once it is removed, it will not come back.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_51: We have discovered a City-State! Establishing diplomatic relations with them will surely be beneficial for our empire. Perhaps we should send them an envoy…
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_52: There are several different types of City-States, and each may provide different benefits in return for our friendship. Our government, over time, will allow us to earn envoys to grow these relationships.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_53: We have trained our first ranged unit, capable of hitting enemies from afar, while out of the range of hand-to-hand combat.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_54: A siege unit! This will surely be useful if we choose to engage in a city attack.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_55: We are now skilled in the construction of walls to protect our cities. In addition to providing protection from invaders, they are also excellent vantage points to bombard enemies with ranged attacks.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_56: The enemy has surrounded the city and we are under siege. We must break this blockade or we will not be able to reinforce the garrison and repair our defenses.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_57: My liege, this city has great defenses. With enough force, and the right military, I think we can take it.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_58: Your majesty, there are times when peace is not the better option. I think we now have good reason to show our military might, but it is a careful decision that you must make alone.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_59: It is a difficult world to face alone, but if I may, I do believe that one of our neighbors has proven worthy. Shall we extend the hand of friendship to them?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_6: We have the opportunity to develop a formal Trade Route between two cities. A Trader unit is required to establish such a route, which would be very beneficial for our economy.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_60: Your excellency, I feel it is time that we send a diplomatic delegation to those around us. This will allow us to sow the seeds of friendship, and perhaps give us a better insight as to what these other people may be doing.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_61: I have good news! If we wish it, I think we may have an ally amongst our neighbors. This could come in handy if we ever find ourselves in need of help.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_62: Do not distress, my liege. There are those out there who cannot be pleased, no matter what. It is important to remember what you stand for, and if the time comes… to fight for it.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_63: My liege, I must warn you that denouncing other civilizations will have long and lasting consequences. It is important to think carefully on these matters.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_64: Though it appears as if we may have offended someone, do not fret. There will always be other leaders with different ideas than our own.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_65: It seems that our choices have won favor with one of our neighbors. But everyone has their own agenda, and I am sure that someone else may be watching us warily.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_66: Your grace, If I may, I think it is time that we begin exploring what is beyond our shores. It may be that our land units would be fit for this opportunity.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_67: It isn't just our lands that can be improved, but our waterways as well. I suggest we search for opportunities to exploit the resources along the shores.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_68: I think we may have an opportunity to convince the followers of another religion of the error of their ways. Shall we seize this opportunity?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_69: Foreign proselytizers have been seeking audience with our citizens. I must advise that we do something about this threat to our holy lands. Perhaps we should launch an inquisition.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_7: In addition to bringing riches to our civilization, this Trade Route will gradually develop Roads between our cities. Roads allow our units to no longer be impaired by the difficult terrain through which they pass.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_70: Neighborhoods with higher appeal will house more citizens, whereas neighborhoods built by marsh, airports, or rainforest are not going to be very populated at all.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_71: Our treasury is filled with gold, and I think it could be wise to make an investment. Perhaps we could expand our military.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_72: We have not yet constructed a Holy Site, and the great prophet that we have attracted to our city has nowhere to go. Let's construct one!
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_73: Our populace has attracted a Great Prophet to our lands! Send this most holy person to Stonehenge and rejoice, for the time has come to found a religion for ourselves.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_74: A Great Engineer has come to our civilization, ready to work hard to advance our infrastructure. Each has a different talent, but all of them can improve our cities in some way.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_75: We now have the ability to build a Spaceport. If we further our research, we may be able to unlock the mysteries of the stars.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_76: We have uncovered a way to increase our farming output. To tap into this potential, I suggest we try to maintain two adjacent farms to each plot of farmland.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_77: We have furthered our agricultural technology yet again! Each farm that we build next to another will increase the output of both - I suggest we do this as often as possible.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_78: Times have changed, and the era of diplomatic delegations has passed. It is important that we now establish Embassies with our friends and allies.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_79: This earth is a gift, and it is important that we protect it. I recommend we establish a National Park. It may even attract tourists!
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_80: It isn't simply seagulls that flock to our shores now. If we build a Seaside Resort, we may be able to benefit from this new attraction to the ocean.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_81: Though our own people are quite skilled, we can always benefit by learning from others. Perhaps we should look into beginning a Research Agreement with one of our neighbors.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_82: A Relic! If we can house this for our people to see, I am certain that it will attract more of the faithful to our lands.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_83: It appears we have become quite a popular attraction to the people of the world. I wonder how many more tourists will travel through our borders…
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_84: You are a brave and mighty conqueror! I have great faith that you will soon rule all of the lands before us.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_85: Our religion spreads throughout the lands. It is a great joy to see so many people embracing what we know to be true. Though, there are still more who have yet to see the light.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_86: Though our population grows, there is little room for our newest citizens. We should find a way to add more housing to this city.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_87: Your grace, I worry about the happiness of our citizens. I would advise that we investigate a means of increasing their contentment.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_88: Our people have discovered that they have a particular, useful skill that I think we should explore. If we begin construction on this new district now, I believe we will have it completed in no time at all.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_89: Alas, all of this time that we spend at war is taking a toll on our people. I see pain in their eyes, and our productivity has reached record lows.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_9: This military unit has proven themselves. From the experience they have gained in combat they are eligible to be granted a promotion. How will you award these brave souls?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_90: The building of an Archeological Museum will allow us to train Archeologists. There is so much to learn from the world, and they will help us gain this knowledge.

en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_2: Our explorers on the frontier have discovered a Barbarian camp. This is the source of the Barbarians threatening our region. We must destroy this stronghold, or they will continue to plague us.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_3: I would advise you to use caution. The Barbarian camp is heavily defended by their best troops and will be hard to take. We should send an assault force of multiple military units to ensure victory.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_4: Your Excellency, I am happy to announce that because of our city's prosperity, our [ICON_Citizen] Population has grown!
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_5: Your Majesty, if I may… Although our scientists would be willing to explore other topics of research, I feel it is best to not distract them until they have completed their current project unless absolutely necessary.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_7: Our explorers have spotted another friendly Tribal Village. I suggest we send our Scouts to investigate it.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_8: A good city can become a great city through careful planning. Deciding where to place a city district is an important decision. Be sure to pick a location best suited to reap the most benefit.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_1: Greetings My Liege! As your personal advisor, I am qualified to assist you in all matters related to ruling our civilization. I am at your service.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_10: Our Warriors were victorious! They fought well to defend our people against this threat. However, the Barbarians are still envious of our civilization. We should be prepared in case they return in greater force.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_11: There are other matters, Your Excellency.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_12: Since Warrior training is complete, it is time to assign a new production task to the city.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_13: The lands surrounding our city could be bountiful if we develop them. We should train Builders to create improvements to the lands within our borders.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_14: There are mysteries that await us outside our borders in the uncharted lands beyond. The only way to find out is to explore.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_15: Your Majesty, our Warriors have discovered a small Tribal Village whose inhabitants are welcoming and friendly. Shall we investigate it and send the Warriors to speak with them?
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_16: It appears that the Tribal Villagers are also harassed by the Barbarians. They are impressed by our culture, and have decided to join us in the fight!
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_17: Good news indeed! They are skillful Scouts and wily travelers. They can move faster than our Warriors, making them ideal for exploring the surrounding lands, but they are not as strong in combat. They eagerly await your orders.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_18: Scouts are excellent at exploring, but they are not as strong in combat as our Warriors. It is better to have them focus on exploration and survival rather than fighting our enemies.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_19: A team of Builders has finished their training in our city. They are ready to work on improving the surrounding lands. There are ideal locations for the growing of [ICON_Food] Food to support our populace. Constructing a Farm there would increase our yield from those lands.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_2: All great civilizations begin with a great city, and our Settlers have found an ideal location. Order them to found a new city here.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_20: Your Majesty, it is once again time to choose where to direct the production efforts of our city. Your leadership is without equal and our civilization continues to thrive. Shall we construct a Monument to honor our civilization's growing greatness?
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_21: With Barbarians in our midst, I think our people would be more comfortable if our Warriors were closer to the city. Order them to return and defend.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_22: Your Majesty, our Scouts are eager to explore the surrounding lands and uncover new areas of the continent. Send them forth!
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_23: There are no further matters to attend to at present, My Liege.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_24: Our brightest minds have discovered new and ingenious ways to extract precious stones and metals from the earth. There is an abundance of valuable Stone nearby, it would be wise to send our Builders to construct a Quarry there.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_26: Our citizens are comforted by the return of our Warriors to the city. Might I suggest having them adopt a more defensive stance for the time being? They will be vigilant against the Barbarian threat.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_27: Great news! Our craftsmen have completed the Monument in our city! It is a symbol of the accomplishments and perseverance of our civilization, and inspires our people to push even further into the lands beyond.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_28: Your Majesty, we should expand our realm. We have adventurous families ready to strike out and claim new lands for the glory of our people. If we do not expand our borders, then in time we will find ourselves surrounded by our enemies.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_29: Settlers will take some time to complete their training. Our Scout should continue exploring undiscovered lands. I would advise we keep our Warriors in the [ICON_Capital] Capital to defend it.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_3: Well done! You have founded your first city. From these roots your civilization will grow to stand the test of time. Now you must nurture and protect what you have created.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_30: The Settlers are ready to embark on their journey to found a new city and expand our civilization. The lands beyond are dangerous, and it would be wise to insure their protection by sending them with a military escort.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_31: Our Settlers should be safe on their journey under the protection of our Warriors. But we will be without protection in the [ICON_Capital] Capital once they leave. I suggest we begin training a Slinger unit immediately to defend the city.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_32: Well done, Your Majesty. Our great minds have already begun work on new ways to store and preserve our food.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_33: May the triumphs of our great civilization know no bounds! Our second great city awaits your direction. With your wise leadership it too shall grow and thrive.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_34: Like our [ICON_Capital] Capital, this city can produce buildings and units, increase its population, and expand its borders. More cities means more to manage, but I have great faith in Your Majesty.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_36: Your Majesty has shown wisdom and understanding in the fundamentals of ruling a civilization. I shall be available to assist you at any point should you wish, but for now I take my leave.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_37: Our farmers are very skilled at providing [ICON_Food] Food for our people, but we need to find better ways to store it. I suggest we direct the efforts of our scientists to solving this problem.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_39: Our dedication to developing a consistent written language has allowed us to record our knowledge for future use. If we were to provide a common location in our city for our scientists to share this information I'm sure their pursuits would be much more efficient.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_4: Security is of great importance. There are barbaric tribes near us who want nothing more than to pillage and plunder what is ours.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_40: Excellent! Construction on a Campus has begun. Our scientists look forward to its completion.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_41: The Campus is complete and we have already begun to see its benefits. Construction of a Library would be ideal at such a location, should your highness agree to it.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_42: It seems we are not the only people competing for control of these lands. I suggest we proceed with caution.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_43: Your Highness we are at war. Security of the realm is of greatest importance. We must begin mobilizing an army immediately.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_44: Uniting your governance with a strict code of laws can be most beneficial to us. I think it is time to enact a set of policies to strengthen our progress toward a more refined civilization.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_45: Strict discipline in our military ranks would give us an edge against the unorganized Barbarian horde. More structured Urban Planning will make our cities more organized and efficient. I suggest we enact these policies.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_46: Nurturing our populace is important, but we must also protect them. There are barbaric tribes near us who want nothing more than to pillage and plunder what is ours.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_47: We continue to make progress on training a team of Builders, and research is continuing as planned. [NEWLINE] Our Warriors are very close to the Tribal Village and should arrive soon.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_48: Our people have looked to the heavens, and begun to wonder if our fortunes may be guided by the hands of a greater power. Who are these great gods, and what blessings might they bestow on us?
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_49: In a life dedicated to searching for guidance in the mysteries of the universe, one has had an epiphany that will guide our faithful for millennia to come. Let the teachings of this Great Prophet spread people of all cultures across the face of the earth. By proliferating our Religion, we may be victorious over our rivals.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_5: Direct the production efforts of this city to train Warriors to deal with this impending threat.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_50: Congratulations, My Liege! Your leadership has inspired our people to greatness, and now one among them has attained true genius. Their contribution will reverberate throughout history.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_51: Your Majesty, we must reach out to our neighbors in trade. Through them, we stand to boost our economy, and gain new insights into the mysteries of the world.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_52: My Liege, we have made contact with some outsiders. These people are more advanced than the Tribal Villagers that have aided us in the past. Should we extend a hand in friendship, or seek to conquer them?
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_53: Caution, your majesty. This city is hostile to us and its people will surely fight to the bitter end to keep it out of our hands. We must be well prepared
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_6: Training has begun, but it will be some time before our new Warriors are ready. There are no further matters to attend to right now.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_7: Your city is busy training Warriors for its defense, but a great civilization cannot thrive on military might alone. We have people talented in the ways of science and discovery. You should employ them in researching new technologies which will advance our civilization.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_8: Wise decision, Your Majesty. This technology will let us better extract the riches from the earth and increase [ICON_Production] Production in our cities. I will let you know when we have finished our research.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_9: Your Majesty, hostile Barbarians have been seen near our [ICON_Capital] Capital. If left alone they are sure to attack our people and pillage our lands. Your newly trained Warriors await your orders to attack!
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_BARBARIAN_CAMP_DISCO: In developing your military, it is always a good strategy to diversify. Not all units are created equal, some are better against others, and have abilities that separate them from the rest.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_CITY_POPULATION_CHAN: The [ICON_Citizen] Population of your first city has grown from 1 to 2. As long as a city is well fed and its people are happy, it will continue to grow. The [ICON_Citizen] Citizens of the city work the surrounding plots and improvements contributing to greater yields. Higher [ICON_Citizen] Populations contribute to faster [ICON_Science] Science research, faster city [ICON_Production] Production, and faster [ICON_Culture] Cultural growth.
It is always a good strategy to not only found new cities to expand your realm, but also to grow those cities.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_INTRO: As your advisor I am qualified to assist you in all matters related to ruling our civilization.[NEWLINE]If you do not require my service, you can dismiss me to attend to other matters.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_NATURAL_WONDER_REVEA: In Civilization VI, you can get Eureka Moments that boost your technology research through in game achievements. This Eureka Moment was gained by discovering a natural wonder. Other achievements could be winning a battle with a specific unit or constructing a building. Achieving these greatly accelerates your technological progress.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_SELECT_END_TURN: There are no more pressing issues at this time. Shall we continue with our duties?
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_AIRPOWER_DESCRIPTION: Tries to build up air power. Admires civilizations with greater air power. Dislikes civilizations with weaker air power.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_ALLY_OF_ENKIDU_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations who are willing to form a long-term alliance. Dislikes anyone denouncing or attacking his friends and allies.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_AYYUBID_DYNASTY_DESCRIPTION: Wants to have his Worship building in many cities, and likes a civilization with it. Dislikes civilizations following other Religions, or civilizations waging war on followers of his Religion.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_BACKSTAB_AVERSE_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations who are their declared friend. Hates civilizations who backstab and declare surprise wars.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_BARBARIAN_LOVER_DESCRIPTION: Sympathizes with the barbarians.  Does not like civilizations that destroy barbarian outposts.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_BIG_STICK_POLICY_DESCRIPTION: Likes peaceful civilizations that have a city on his home continent. Hates civilizations starting wars against a city-state or civilization based on his continent.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_BLACK_QUEEN_DESCRIPTION: Gains as many Spies and as much diplomatic access as possible.  Does not like civilizations who ignore these espionage activities.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_BUSHIDO_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations that have a strong military and [ICON_Faith]Faith and [ICON_Culture] Culture output. Dislikes civilizations that are strong in military but weak in [ICON_Faith]Faith and [ICON_Culture] Culture output.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_CITY_STATE_ALLY_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations that aren't competing for the same city-state allegiance. Dislikes civilizations that are directly competing for city-state allegiance.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_CITY_STATE_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPT: Emphasizes protectorate wars. Admires civilizations that start protectorate wars. Dislikes civilizations that attack city states.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_CIVILIZED_DESCRIPTION: Hates barbarians. Likes civilizations that clear out barbarian outposts. Does not like civilizations that ignore barbarian outposts.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_COUNTER_REFORMER_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations who follow the same Religion, and wants their cities to all follow the same Religion.  Hates anyone trying to spread their Religion into their empire.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_CULTURED_DESCRIPTION: Tries to build up [ICON_Culture] Culture, and likes civilizations that also focus on [ICON_Culture] Culture.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_DARWINIST_DESCRIPTION: Likes to see civilizations at war, and believes in constant struggle.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_DELIAN_LEAGUE_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations that aren't competing for the same city-state allegiance. Dislikes civilizations that are directly competing for city-state allegiance.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_DEVOUT_DESCRIPTION: Tries to build up [ICON_Faith] Faith, and likes civilizations that also focus on [ICON_Faith] Faith.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_ENTHUSIASTIC_DISCIPLE_DESCRIP: Likes civilizations that bring Religion to the Kongo. Dislikes civilizations that have founded a Religion but not brought it to a Kongolese city.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_ENVIRONMENTALIST_DESCRIPTION: Builds National Parks, doesn't clear features, plants Woods. Likes civilizations that plant Woods or found National Parks. Dislikes civilizations that clear features.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_EXPLOITATIVE_DESCRIPTION: Clears all features and improves all possible tiles. Likes civilizations with a high percentage of improved tiles. Dislikes civilizations with low percentage of improved tiles or that found National Parks.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION: Tries to explore the map, and likes civilizations that have explored less of the map than itself and dislikes civilizations that have explored more of the map than itself.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_FUN_LOVING_DESCRIPTION: Tries to make the citizens in each city as happy as possible. Likes civilizations that also develop in this fashion.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_GREAT_PERSON_OBSESSED_DESCRIP: Likes civilizations who are not competing for [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People, and will recruit [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People whenever possible. Dislikes losing a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person to another civilization.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_IDEOLOGUE_DESCRIPTION: Favors civilizations with the same type of government, dislikes civilizations that have different governments, and really dislikes civilizations with different governments of the same era as its own.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_INDUSTRIALIST_DESCRIPTION: Tries to build up industry, and likes civilizations that also focus on [ICON_Production] Production.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_IRON_CROWN_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations who do not associate with city-states. Does not like Suzerains of city-states, or civilizations who conquered city-states.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_LAST_VIKING_KING_DESCRIPTION: Builds a large navy and respects civilizations who follow their lead.  Does not like civilizations with a weak navy.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_MONEY_GRUBBER_DESCRIPTION: Tries to have the highest possible [ICON_Gold] Gold per turn income. Respects other high income civilizations.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_NATURALIST_DESCRIPTION: Tries to find all natural wonders.  Likes civilizations that keep Woods and Rainforest unchopped, and those that establish National Parks.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_NUKE_LOVER_DESCRIPTION: Has no hesitation to use nuclear weapons. Respects other civilizations that project strength with nuclear weapons.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_OPTIMUS_PRINCEPS_DESCRIPTION: Tries to include as much territory as possible in their empire.  Does not like civilizations who control little territory.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_PARANOID_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations who pose no threat. Dislikes civilizations with strong militaries or ones with nearby cities.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_PEACEKEEPER_DESCRIPTION: Never declares wars for which he can be branded a warmonger, and will try to befriend those who maintain the peace. Hates warmongers.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_POPULOUS_DESCRIPTION: Tries to have the highest overall population.  Respects other high population civilizations.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_QUEEN_OF_THE_NILE_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations with powerful militaries, and will try to ally with them to avoid damaging military conflicts. Dislikes civilizations with weak militaries.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_STANDING_ARMY_DESCRIPTION: Always tries to keep a large standing army. Respects other civilizations with large armies.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_SUN_NEVER_SETS_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations from her home continent, and wants to expand to all continents. Doesn’t like civilizations on continents where England has no city.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_TECHNOPHILE_DESCRIPTION: Tries to build up [ICON_Science] Science, and likes civilizations that also focus on [ICON_Science] Science.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_TLATOANI_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations who have the same Luxury resources as he does, and will try to collect every Luxury resource available. Dislikes civilizations who have a new Luxury resource he has not yet collected.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_WESTERNIZER_DESCRIPTION: Friendly to those civilizations that are ahead of him in [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture.  Dislikes backwards civilizations that are lacking in [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_WITH_YOUR_SHIELD_OR_ON_IT_DES: Never gives up items in a peace deal, and likes civilizations who match that approach. Dislikes civilizations who have capitulated or who have never gone to war.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_WITH_YOUR_SHIELD_OR_ON_IT_NAM: With Your Shield Or On It
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_WONDER_OBSESSED_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations not competing for wonders, and builds wonders whenever possible. Dislikes losing a wonder to another civilization.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_ZEALOT_DESCRIPTION: Tries to gain a religious victory. Likes those civs who have already adopted their religion.

en_US.LOC_BELIEF_CATHEDRAL_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Cathedrals (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, 1 slot for religious art).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_CHORAL_MUSIC_DESCRIPTION: Shrines and Temples provide [ICON_Culture] Culture equal to their intrinsic [ICON_Faith] Faith output.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_CHURCH_PROPERTY_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold for each city following this Religion.

en_US.LOC_BELIEF_CROSS_CULTURAL_DIALOGUE_DESCR: +1 [ICON_Science] Science for every 5 followers of this Religion in other civilizations.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DANCE_OF_THE_AURORA_DESCRIPTI: Holy Site districts get +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith from adjacent Tundra tiles.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DAR_E_MEHR_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Dar-e Mehrs (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 additional [ICON_FAITH] for each era since constructed or last repaired).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DEFENDER_OF_FAITH_DESCRIPTION: Combat units gain +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when within the borders of friendly cities that follow this Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DESERT_FOLKLORE_DESCRIPTION: Holy Site districts get +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith from adjacent Desert tiles.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DIVINE_SPARK_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person point from Holy Site (Prophet), Campus (Scientist), and Theater Square (Writer) districts.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_EARTH_GODDESS_DESCRIPTION: +1 Faith [ICON_Faith] from tiles with Charming or better Appeal.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_FEED_THE_WORLD_DESCRIPTION: Shrines and Temples provide [ICON_Food] Food equal to their intrinsic [ICON_Faith] Faith output.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GODDESS_OF_FESTIVALS_DESCRIPT: +1 [ICON_Food] Food from [ICON_RESOURCE_WINE] Wine, [ICON_RESOURCE_INCENSE] Incense, [ICON_RESOURCE_COCOA] Cocoa, [ICON_RESOURCE_TOBACCO] Tobacco, [ICON_RESOURCE_COFFEE] Coffee, and [ICON_RESOURCE_TEA] Tea Plantations.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GODDESS_OF_THE_HARVEST_DESCRI: Harvesting a resource or removing a feature receives [ICON_Faith] Faith equal to the other yield's quantity.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GOD_OF_CRAFTSMEN_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_Production] Production from Mines over Strategic resources.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GOD_OF_HEALING_DESCRIPTION: Increases Healing by +30 in your Holy Site district, or any adjacent tiles.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GOD_OF_THE_FORGE_DESCRIPTION: +25% [ICON_Production] Production toward Ancient and Classical military units.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GOD_OF_WAR_DESCRIPTION: Bonus [ICON_Faith] Faith equal to 50% of the strength of each combat unit killed within 8 tiles of a Holy Site district. (on Standard Speed)
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GURDWARA_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Gurdwaras (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +2 [ICON_Food] Food).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_HOLY_ORDER_DESCRIPTION: Missionaries and Apostles are 30% cheaper to purchase.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_INITIATION_RITES_DESCRIPTION: +50 [ICON_Faith] Faith for each Barbarian Outpost cleared.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_ITINERANT_PREACHERS_DESCRIPTI: Religion spreads to cities 30% further away.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_JESUIT_EDUCATION_DESCRIPTION: May purchase Campus and Theater Square district buildings with [ICON_Faith] Faith.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_JUST_WAR_DESCRIPTION: Combat units gain +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when within the borders of foreign cities that follow this Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_LADY_OF_THE_REEDS_AND_MARSHES: +1 [ICON_Production] Production from Marsh, Oasis, and Floodplains.
Lady of the Reeds and Marshes
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_LAY_MINISTRY_DESCRIPTION: Each Holy Site or Theater Square district in a city following this Religion provides +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith or +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture respectively.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_MEETING_HOUSE_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Meeting Houses (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +2 [ICON_Production] Production).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_MISSIONARY_ZEAL_DESCRIPTION: Religious units ignore [ICON_Movement] Movement costs of terrain and features.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_MONASTIC_ISOLATION_DESCRIPTIO: Your Religion's pressure never drops due to losses in Theological Combat.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_MONUMENT_TO_THE_GODS_DESCRIPT: +15% [ICON_Production] Production towards Ancient and Classical era wonders.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_MOSQUE_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Mosques (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith). Missionaries and Apostles +1 Spread.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_ORAL_TRADITION_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture from [ICON_RESOURCE_BANANAS] Banana, [ICON_RESOURCE_CITRUS] Citrus, [ICON_RESOURCE_COTTON] Cotton, [ICON_RESOURCE_DYES] Dyes, [ICON_RESOURCE_SILK] Silk, [ICON_RESOURCE_SPICES] Spices, and [ICON_RESOURCE_SUGAR] Sugar Plantations.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_PAGODA_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Pagodas (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_PAPAL_PRIMACY_DESCRIPTION: Type bonuses from city-states following your Religion are 50% more powerful.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_PILGRIMAGE_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every city following this Religion in other civilizations and City-States.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_COLONIZATION_DESCRI: Cities start with this Religion in place if founded by a player who has this as their majority Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_COMMUNITY_DESCRIPTI: Shrines and Temples each provide +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_IDOLS_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith from Mines over Luxury and Bonus resources.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_UNITY_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy at each City-State when it first adopts this Religion, in addition to any envoy from a City-State quest.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIQUARIES_DESCRIPTION: [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics have triple yield of both [ICON_Faith] Faith and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RIVER_GODDESS_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity to cities if they have a Holy Site district adjacent to a River.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_SACRED_PATH_DESCRIPTION: Holy Site districts get +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith from adjacent Rainforest tiles.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_SCRIPTURE_DESCRIPTION: Religious spread from adjacent city pressure is 25% stronger. Boosted to 50% once Printing is researched.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_STEWARDSHIP_DESCRIPTION: Each Campus or Commercial Hub district in a city following this Religion provides +1 [ICON_Science] Science or +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold respectively.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_STUPA_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Stupas (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_TITHE_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold for every 4 followers of this Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WARRIOR_MONKS_DESCRIPTION: Allows spending [ICON_Faith] Faith to train Warrior Monks, medieval land combat units with a unique promotion tree. May only be purchased in a city with a Temple in its Holy Site.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WAT_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Wats (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +2 [ICON_Science] Science).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WORK_ETHIC_DESCRIPTION: +1% [ICON_Production] Production for each citizen following this religion in the city.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WORLD_CHURCH_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture for every 5 followers of this Religion in other civilizations.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_ZEN_MEDITATION_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity in cities with 2 specialty districts.

en_US.LOC_BLACKDEATH_SCENARIO_DESCRIPTION: In this scenario you must guide a Medieval civilization through the infamous Black Death, keeping their cultural and scientific efforts alive as their population falls and faith collapses. The plague will sweep the landscape in waves, killing citizens and rendering tiles unworkable. Can you hold on long enough to sow the seeds of the Enlightenment, or will your nation collapse into disloyalty and despair?
en_US.LOC_BLACKDEATH_SCENARIO_TOOLTIP: Can you guide your nation through the terrible plague? 4 players, 85 turns.

en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_BALLISTICS: Have 2 Forts in your territory. Both constructed by a Military Engineer.
