en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_CHOICE_NEGATIVE: Our capital is not open to visitors at this time.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_ANY_ANY: Will you receive our diplomatic delegation in your capital?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_BARB: We have sent a diplomatic envoy to you. Treat them as you would treat me, the Duke of Swabia, King of Burgundy, King of Germany, King of the Romans, King of Italy, and Holy Roman Emperor.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_CATH: I have sent you a trade delegation with all of the customary gifts : herbs, olives, various cheeses, and baguettes to eat them with, of course.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_CLEO: My diplomatic delegation brings you a small gift of papyrus from the New Isis. Welcome them as you would welcome me.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_GAND: I have sent a trade delegation to you with gifts from our land: teas, sarees, and sitars.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_GILG: The delegation of Gilgamesh brings you gifts of Sumerian jewelry, and lyres from Ur. Will you accept them into your city?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_GORG: A Spartan delegation honors you with gifts of olive oil and black broth. Accept them with honor.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_HARD: I have sent you traders with gifts of rune stones. They are powerful - the stones, not the traders.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_HOJO: We have sent you a delegation with gifts of yosegi-zukuri, some of our greatest works.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_MONT: Gifts of maize and chocolate are brought to you by my delegation. We offer them to you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_MVEM: My trade delegation should be arriving soon with fufu. Enjoy the meal!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_PEDR: Will you receive our diplomatic delegation in your capital?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_PERI: We have sent you a delegation bearing gifts. Don’t be alarmed, there’s no large wooden horse involved.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_PETE: I have sent you a trade delegation bearing gifts of the finest caviar. Please enjoy.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_PHIL: I have sent a delegation to your city. Please, enjoy the churros and welcome them kindly.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_QIN_: Our trade delegation should be arriving soon with gifts of the finest spices, tea, and silk in the Middle Kingdom. Please, enjoy.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_SALA: I have sent a delegation to you with gifts from our empire. They bring the sweetest fruit, rare snow to cool you on even the hottest day, and the most excellent of horses. Please receive them as our courtesy.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_TOMY: I have sent you a trade delegation bearing a decorated gorytos as a gift for you. You do have a bow, yes?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_TRAJ: I have sent a trade delegation to you. Enjoy the Pecorino Romano: the finest salted, sheep's-milk cheese you will ever have.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_T_RO: It’s good to see you. My diplomatic delegation should be arriving soon with some fresh-baked apple pies. I’m sure you’ll give them a warm welcome.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_VICT: Greetings. We have sent a Royal envoy on behalf of the United Kingdom. We hope they are well received.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_ANY_ANY: The world needs to be aware of your transgressions (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_BARBAR: The world will know of your treachery. And you will be judged. (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_CATHER: I don't like the look of what you've been up to. What would your friends think of this information? (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_CLEOPA: You are worse than Brutus and Cassius combined. The world will know the truth! (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_GANDHI: You are untrustworthy; this is the worst kind of violence. (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_GILGAM: Let the world hear my words: you are as treacherous as Ishtar.(Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_GORGO_: You are worse than sophists. Let the rest of the world know. (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_HARDRA: There will be no place for you at Odin’s table. You are a disgrace.(Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_HOJO_A: You are a foolish, simple leader. And your people should know the truth. (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_MONTEZ: You are a poison to this world. You are evil! (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_MVEMBA: You are an evil upon this world. Your name will be cursed for ages. (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_PEDRO_: The world needs to be aware of your transgressions (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_PERICL: Tyrants such as you are abominations. Your people will know the truth of my words. (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_PETER_: I have seen much in my life, but I have never seen such a despicable leader. You should be ashamed, and will be. (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_PHILIP: You are another Judas, come to betray the Lord. (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_QIN_AN: Your reputation is forever tarnished. (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_SALADI: It is said by my people that the house of a tyrant is a ruin… and all I see is ruin around you. (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_TOMYRI: You are a wretched liar and cannot be trusted! You are the worst of your kind. (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_TRAJAN: You are a disgrace. I will tell the world, they will know who you truly are. (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_T_ROOS: I cannot abide a ruler without dignity, and the world must be made aware. (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_VICTOR: We will have nothing to do with your administration. You are hereby denounced. (Denounces You)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_ANY_ANY: This situation is going to get worse before it gets any better.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_BAR: I should answer you with my sword…  perhaps I will.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_CAT: The glory and might of France will not be tarnished by such obvious lies.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_CLE: You dare insult the New Isis?!? You will regret this!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_GAN: Your lies will not be believed by the wise, and the foolish will learn their lesson.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_GIL: Hah! Gilgamesh is stronger than your false words.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_GOR: Your words are meaningless compared to our deeds.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_HAR: Hah, I’ve burned kingdoms for lesser insults. You’ll pay for this.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_HOJ: Empty words are no threat. Show me action, purpose, discipline!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_MON: Those who are afraid speak loudest. You fear us.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_MVE: I have done nothing wrong, and the people of Kongo do not deserve your slander.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_PED: This situation is going to get worse before it gets any better.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_PER: All leaders incur hatred and unpopularity; if one has a great aim to pursue, this burden of envy must be accepted.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_PET: My people live through winters more dangerous than your army. Do you think we’re afraid of your threats?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_PHI: There is no greater sin than to defy the anointed servant of the Lord. You will pay dearly for this.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_QIN: So, an insect dares to offend a dragon. That was not wise.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_SAL: Everyone is critical of the flaws of others, but blind to their own.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_TOM: No one will believe your hollow lies. Tomyris is a good friend to the worthy.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_TRA: So, it is true: one who is full of envy, disparages everything, good or bad.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_VIC: The Queen wishes to warn those who disrespect her people and her mandate of the manifold troubles that will ensue.

en_US.LOC_DIPLO_EMBASSY_CHOICE_NEGATIVE: Our capital is not accepting new residents at this time.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_EMBASSY_CHOICE_POSITIVE: Your embassy is a welcome addition to our capital.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_EMBASSY_FROM_AI_ANY_ANY: Will you allow us to establish an embassy in your capital?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_ANY_ANY: Greetings traveler. You should know that you stand in the presence of greatness!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_BARBAROSSA_A: Greetings. I am the Holy Roman Emperor Frederick, King of Germany, Italy, Burgundy, and many others. I trust that you will rule your lands as I do:  through might.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_CATHERINE_DE: I am Catherine, the Queen Mother of France, and I welcome you to the realm. I do so look forward to learning all there is to know about you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_CLEOPATRA_AN: I am Isis reborn, I am the living Nile. I am Cleopatra and an ally, if you are worthy.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_GANDHI_ANY: Hello, I am Mohandas Gandhi. My people call me Bapu, but please, call me friend.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_GILGAMESH_AN: I am Gilgamesh of Sumeria and King of Uruk. Do not be afraid… I am good to my friends.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_GORGO_ANY: I am Gorgo, Queen of Sparta and leader of the Greeks. Who are you? What victories can you speak of?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_HARDRADA_ANY: Harald Sigurdsson stands before you: a Viking unlike any the seas and lands have ever known. Hah, are you afraid?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_HOJO_ANY: Hello, I am Hojo Tokimune of Japan, a humble disciple of Bushido.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_MONTEZUMA_AN: I am the scowling lord of Tenochtitlan. The tlatoani. Who comes before me? A warrior or a coward?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_MVEMBA_ANY: I am Mvemba a Nzinga and I greet you as a friend. I can see you are blessed by God. Are you here to share your enlightenment?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_PEDRO_ANY: Good day. It is an honor to meet you in person. It seems great minds do attract each other, after all.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_PERICLES_ANY: Hello, I am Pericles of Athens and I greet you on behalf of the Democracy. I trust you’ll let me conduct my business with these neutral parties?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_PETER_GREAT_: Hello, I am Tsar Peter. So, a cultured leader such as yourself must enjoy the finer things in life. Are you fond of art as well?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_PHILIP_II_AN: I am the King of Spain, Portugal, Sardinia and Sicily, Naples, Duke of Milan, etc., but most importantly, I am a devout follower of the one, true religion. I hope for your sake you are as well.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_QIN_ANY: Why do you come before the Immortal Son of Heaven, the Great Qin Shi Huang?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_SALADIN_ANY: By the grace of the one God, the powerful, the victorious, the everlasting of whose Kingdom there is no end, I greet you, my sincere friend.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_TOMYRIS_ANY: Let it be known between us: I will repay treachery with blood!  But, if you are a true friend, we will have peace.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_TRAJAN_ANY: Hail, stranger. I am the Imperator Caesar Trajan of far-reaching Rome. Who are you and what lands can you claim as your own?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_T_ROOSEVELT_: Welcome to the United States of America. If you conduct yourself well, you can consider us friends.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_VICTORIA_ANY: Greetings. We are by the Grace of God, Victoria, Queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. And soon, dare I say, the empire.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_NEAR_INITIATOR_POSI: By all means.  It will be a pleasure to see your growing city up close.
By all means.  It will be a pleasure to see your growing city up close.
Yes, yes. This is good for us.
On behalf of the people, yes.

en_US.LOC_EPIC_PBC_OVERVIEW_DESC: Play By Cloud is an asynchronous multiplayer format where all players take their turns on a common savegame, which is stored on a hosted server. This is a more modern version of “passing the savegame,” which was the ancient practice of sharing a floppy disk with a common save file between friends (if you are unfamiliar with the concept of a “floppy disk,” please ask a respected adult of venerable age).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A Play By Cloud game may last a long time (on the order of days or weeks) as each player takes his or her turn at a time that is convenient to them. You will receive notifications when it is your turn to play. You may see an Epic notification if Epic is active, or you may use the webhooks. Webhooks are a generic message format that the technically-inclined can integrate into other messaging services, email, or Internet of Things devices.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In asynchronous multiplayer, it is considered courteous to take your turn at your earliest possible convenience to keep the game moving. In ancient times, players were morally obligated to protect the floppy disk from corruption, with unscrupulous players resorting to “losing” the savegame when in an untenable situation. Play By Cloud eliminates such rascally behavior.
en_US.LOC_EPIC_PRIVATE_GAME_DESC: Private games are not shown in the multiplayer lobby.  A private game is only accessable thru a game invite or the Epic friends list.  This setting does not apply to Local Network games.
en_US.LOC_ERA_ANCIENT_DESCRIPTION: From the first stirrings of life beneath water… to the great beasts of the Stone Age… to man taking his first upright steps, you have come far.  Now begins your greatest quest: from this early cradle of civilization on towards the stars.
en_US.LOC_ERA_ATOMIC_DESCRIPTION: New frontiers of discovery expand our understanding, from the tiny atom to the majesty of outer space. Mysteries long tolerated are closer than ever to revealing their deepest secrets, beyond what we can easily see. You will choose how to use this knowledge, and push back the greatest darkness we have yet faced.
en_US.LOC_ERA_CLASSICAL_DESCRIPTION: From humble beginnings, you have shown remarkable growth. Leave your bronze for iron and rule with horse and sword. The sky above begins to reveal its secrets, a collection of heaven that uplifts our hearts and guides us to foreign shores.
en_US.LOC_ERA_INDUSTRIAL_DESCRIPTION: The steady hum of machinery, the acrid smell of smoke, vision clouded by ash and soot – these are the signs of changing times. The lure of scientific and cultural advancement is the engine driving your realm forward.  Now your challenge is to maintain the delicate balance between earth and man, between peace and war.
en_US.LOC_ERA_INFORMATION_DESCRIPTION: A world of information rests in the palm of your hand, and networks for instantaneous communication span the globe.  Yet a unified vision of our future has never been built.  We compete in technology, culture, and politics. We have deadly weapons that could destroy our planet. Lead us carefully, but boldly, and build a global community that can stand for years to come.
en_US.LOC_ERA_MEDIEVAL_DESCRIPTION: You have built great cities of stone and seen early empires rise and fall.  Soon you will stand under the towering pinnacles of castles alongside your gallant knights. That is where the story of your people will be written. Just as the young apprentice learns to carry a sword, so shall you grow to understand your place in this world.
en_US.LOC_ERA_MODERN_DESCRIPTION: In the beginning, legends of flying men soared. And today, you are on the brink of transforming those legends into a reality. With flight and new forms of communication you can create a small and intimate world.  But at what cost? Our competing ideas of how to govern and how to live threaten to bring conflict on a global scale.  You must choose your own path through this rising din of ideological oratory.
en_US.LOC_ERA_RENAISSANCE_DESCRIPTION: New powers call forth, from the barrel of muskets to flowers of fire in the sky. Even the quiet words on newly printed pages hold great changes within. The world, once so vast and mysterious, has grown smaller and more familiar. Yet, there are always questions to be answered, faiths to be tested, and national identities to be formed.

en_US.LOC_EXPANSION2_MOD_DESCRIPTION: This is a game using the Gathering Storm Expansion, which includes the World Congress, environmental effects and disasters, power, and more. Can you deal with the unpredictability of a changing world to make a civilization that will stand the test of time?
en_US.LOC_EXPANSION2_MOD_TEASER: An Expansion pack with World Congress, environmental effects and disasters, power, new civilizations and leaders, and much, much more!
en_US.LOC_EXPLORED_ALL: You have visited all of the land and sea.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_BARRIER_REEF_DESCRIPTION: Two tile natural wonder that can be found on coastal terrain and provides +3 [ICON_Food] Food and +2 [ICON_Science] Science. Major adjacency bonus to the Campus district.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_BARRIER_REEF_QUOTE: “Organisms don't think of CO2 as a poison. Plants and organisms that make shells, coral, think of it as a building block.”[NEWLINE]– Janine Benyus
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_BARRIER_REEF_SCIENCE: +{1_num} [ICON_SCIENCE] Science from the adjacent natural wonder Great Barrier Reef.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_CLIFFS_DOVER_DESCRIPTION: Two tile natural wonder. It appears with Cliffs adjacent to water and provides +3 [ICON_Culture] Culture, +3 [ICON_Gold] Gold, +2 [ICON_Food] Food. Improvements cannot be placed on it.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_CLIFFS_DOVER_QUOTE: “Under the White Cliff’s battlemented crown, Hushed to a depth of more than Sabbath peace.”[NEWLINE]– William Wordsworth
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_CRATER_LAKE_DESCRIPTION: One tile natural wonder. It appears as a Lake and provides +5 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_Science] Science, and Fresh Water.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_CRATER_LAKE_QUOTE: “Never again can I gaze upon the beauty spots of the Earth and enjoy them as being the finest thing I have ever seen. Crater Lake is above them all.”[NEWLINE]– Jack London
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_DEAD_SEA_DESCRIPTION: Two tile natural wonder. It appears as a Lake and provides +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith and +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture. Units heal completely if they heal for one turn adjacent to the Dead Sea. Does not provide Fresh Water.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_DEAD_SEA_QUOTE: “Like to the apples on the Dead Sea’s shore, all ashes to the taste.”[NEWLINE]– Lord Byron
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_EVEREST_DESCRIPTION: Three tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith to adjacent tiles. Religious units who move next to Mount Everest ignore Hills for the rest of the game.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_EVEREST_QUOTE: “It is not the mountain we conquer but ourselves.”[NEWLINE]– Sir Edmund Hillary
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_GALAPAGOS_DESCRIPTION: Two tile impassable natural wonder. It appears on coastal terrain and provides +2 [ICON_Science] Science to adjacent tiles.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_GALAPAGOS_QUOTE: “The natural history of this archipelago is very remarkable: it seems to be a little world within itself.”[NEWLINE]– Charles Darwin
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_KILIMANJARO_DESCRIPTION: One tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +2 [ICON_Food] Food to adjacent tiles.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_KILIMANJARO_QUOTE: “As it turns out, Mount Kilimanjaro is not wi-fi enabled, so I had to spend two weeks in Tanzania talking to the people on my trip.”[NEWLINE]– Nancy Bonds
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_NATURAL_WONDER_DESCRIPTION: The discovery of a natural wonder gives Scouts bonus experience. Natural wonders also give an adjacency bonus to Holy Site districts. All adjacent tiles receive +2 Appeal.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_PANTANAL_DESCRIPTION: Four tile natural wonder. Provides +2 [ICON_Food] Food and +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_PANTANAL_QUOTE: “The Pantanal is the most complex intertropical alluvional plain of the planet and perhaps the least known area of the world.”[NEWLINE]– Aziz Ab’Saber
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_PIOPIOTAHI_DESCRIPTION: Three tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold to adjacent tiles.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_PIOPIOTAHI_QUOTE: “But as I headed into the heart of New Zealand’s fiordland that same child-like feeling, long lost, of pure unadulterated awe came rushing back. I knew the road to Milford Sound was good – but this good?”[NEWLINE]– Darroch Donald
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_TORRES_DEL_PAINE_DESCRIPTION: Two tile impassable natural wonder. Doubles the terrain yields of all adjacent tiles.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_TORRES_DEL_PAINE_QUOTE: “Several closely situated granite peaks resembling tiger’s teeth dramatically soar about a kilometer into the sky”[NEWLINE]– Howard Hillman
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_TSINGY_DESCRIPTION: One tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +1 [ICON_Science] Science to adjacent tiles.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_TSINGY_QUOTE: “Tsingy is a 250-square-mile tiger trap made up on massive obelisks riddled with jagged spears. And yes, they will cut your pretty face.”[NEWLINE]– Budd Erickson
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_YOSEMITE_DESCRIPTION: Two tile impassable natural wonder. Provides +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold and +1 [ICON_Science] Science to adjacent tiles.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_YOSEMITE_QUOTE: “Yosemite Valley, to me, is always a sunrise, a glitter of green and golden wonder in a vast edifice of stone and space.”[NEWLINE]– Ansel Adams

en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_AUSTEN_1_QUOTE: “A lady's imagination is very rapid; it jumps from admiration to love, from love to matrimony in a moment.”
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_AUSTEN_2_QUOTE: Know your own happiness. You want nothing but patience- or give it a more fascinating name, call it hope.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_BACH_2_NAME: Cello Suite No. 1 in G Major
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_BHASA_1_QUOTE: He is as the fall of a thunderbolt to the lordly mountains,[NEWLINE]the eagle to all the birds, the lion to the assemblies of wild beasts,[NEWLINE]Death, in human form.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_BHASA_2_QUOTE: Oh, my heart, be thou content with the truth of thy suspicions. Learn now of my sire's decease and for a moment be thou calm.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_CAPEK_1_QUOTE: My dear Miss Glory, Robots are not human. Mechanically, they are more perfect than us, they possess an amazing rational intelligence, but they do not have any soul.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_CAPEK_2_QUOTE: Great God of the Ants, thou hast let the victory prevail! I hereby name thee the Colonel.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_CAVENDISH_1_QUOTE: Out of this Room there was a passage into the Emperor's Bed-Chamber, the Walls whereof were of Jet, and the Floor of black Marble; the Roof was of Mother of Pearl, where the Moon and Blazing-Stars were represented by white Diamonds, and his Bed was made of Diamonds and Carbuncles.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_CAVENDISH_2_QUOTE: It is known that man has five Exterior Senses, and every sense is ignorant of each other; for the Nose knows not what the Eyes see, nor the Eyes what the Ears hear, neither do the Ears know what the Tongue tastes...
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_CERVANTES_1_QUOTE: Doubt if you will, but the truth is that which I have told, and forever rests upon lies like oil over water.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_CERVANTES_2_QUOTE: And, being merry and young, they did not miss any chances of hearing about the beautiful maids of the city.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_CHAUCER_1_QUOTE: A KNYGHT ther was, and that a worthy man,[NEWLINE]That fro the tyme that he first bigan[NEWLINE]To riden out, he loved chivalrie,[NEWLINE]Trouthe and honour, fredom and curteisie.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_CHAUCER_2_QUOTE: If I be she that may yow do gladnesse,[NEWLINE]For every wo ye shal recovere a blisse';[NEWLINE]And him in armes took, and gan him kisse.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_DICKINSON_1_QUOTE: A Bird came down the Walk—[NEWLINE]He did not know I saw—[NEWLINE]He bit an Angleworm in halves[NEWLINE]And ate the fellow, raw.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_DICKINSON_2_QUOTE: Success is counted sweetest[NEWLINE]By those who ne'er succeed.[NEWLINE]To comprehend a nectar[NEWLINE]Requires sorest need.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_D_AULNOY_1_QUOTE: And because she was so beautiful they called her Princess Goldilocks; for her hair was finer than gold, wonderfully fair, and it fell in ringlets to her feet.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_D_AULNOY_2_QUOTE: "If you will be so good and generous as to let me free," the dolphin went on, "I shall render you such real services in the course of my life that you will never need to repent of your kindness."
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_FITZGERALD_1_QUOTE: Amory Blaine inherited from his mother every trait, except the stray inexpressible few, that made him worth while.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_FITZGERALD_2_QUOTE: She was dazzling—alight; it was agony to comprehend her beauty in a glance.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_GOETHE_1_QUOTE: As soon as you trust yourself, you will know how to live.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_GOETHE_2_QUOTE: “The human race is a monotonous affair. Most people spend the greatest part of their time working in order to live, and what little freedom remains so fills them with fear that they seek out any and every means to be rid of it.”
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_HOMER_1_QUOTE: Let me not then die ingloriously and without a struggle, but let me first do some great thing that shall be told among men hereafter.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_HOMER_2_QUOTE: For a friend with an understanding heart is worth no less than a brother.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_JOYCE_1_QUOTE: Every life is many days, day after day. We walk through ourselves, meeting robbers, ghosts, giants, old men, young men, wives, widows, brothers-in-love. But always meeting ourselves.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_JOYCE_2_QUOTE: One by one they were all becoming shades. Better pass boldly into that other world, in the full glory of some passion, than fade and wither dismally with age.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_KAUFFMAN_1_NAME: Anna Maria Jenkins and Thomas Jenkins
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_KLIMT_2_NAME: Avenue in the Park of Schloss Kammer
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_LISZT_2_NAME: Mephisto Waltz No. 1 "The Dance in the Village Inn"
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_LI_BAI_1_QUOTE: Flowers surround me, alone with my drink,[NEWLINE]I pour for myself, no companion to join me.[NEWLINE]I raise my glass and toast the full moon,[NEWLINE]Who shall with my shadow make us three.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_LI_BAI_2_NAME: In the Mountains on a Summer Day
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_LI_BAI_2_QUOTE: I fan myself in this most languid heat,[NEWLINE]The forest invites one to lay all bare.[NEWLINE]I hang my hood upon a rocky crag,[NEWLINE]My head exposed I bathe in fragrant air.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_MACHIAVELLI_1_QUOTE: Thus it is necessary to note, men must be either enticed or snuffed out. For light offenses they avenge, grievous ones they cannot; therefore the offense done to a man must be such as to remove any fear of revenge.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_MACHIAVELLI_2_QUOTE: It is necessary for the one who founds a republic, and sets laws in it, to presuppose all men evil, and always ready to put the maliciousness in their soul to use, every time they have a chance...
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_MURASAKI_1_QUOTE: As a young boy my brother Nobunori studied the Chinese classics, and I liked to sit in and listen to his lessons. I found that even when he struggled to understand or memorize passages, I would find them remarkably easy. My father, a well-read man himself, often used to lament this fact, saying, 'Such a shame. Would that you were born a man!'
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_MURASAKI_2_QUOTE: New grass, you don’t even know where to sprout and grow. How can I, a drop of dew, vanish away in the air leaving you alone?
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_OVID_1_QUOTE: I held up a fistful of sand and showed it to him, asking for as many years as grains in that pile. Foolish me! I forgot to ask they be years of youth.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_OVID_2_QUOTE: Chance is all-powerful. Always cast your fishing hook; in the pond where you least expect it, you'll find a fish.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_POE_1_QUOTE: "Villains!" I shrieked, "dissemble no more! I admit the deed! --tear up the planks! here, here! --It is the beating of his hideous heart!"
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_POE_2_QUOTE: While I nodded, nearly napping, suddenly there came a tapping,[NEWLINE]As of some one gently rapping, rapping at my chamber door.[NEWLINE]“’Tis some visitor,” I muttered, “tapping at my chamber door—[NEWLINE]Only this and nothing more.”
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_PUSHKIN_1_QUOTE: Dreams, dreams! Where have you gone? How sweet you were.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_PUSHKIN_2_QUOTE: Like some magistrate grown gray in office,[NEWLINE]Calmly he contemplates alike the just[NEWLINE]And unjust, with indifference he notes[NEWLINE]Evil and good, and knows not wrath nor pity.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_QU_YUAN_1_QUOTE: From the light came light, and from the dark came darkness, but from whence did they appear? Yin and yang combine to create all things, but which is the source, and which was born from it?
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_QU_YUAN_2_QUOTE: Time rolls ever forward without a pause,[NEWLINE]The seasons cycle through spring and autumn.[NEWLINE]As I watch the green fade all around me,[NEWLINE]I fear the sun setting on my youth.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_SHAKESPEARE_1_QUOTE: O, swear not by the moon, the inconstant moon,[NEWLINE]That monthly changes in her circled orb,[NEWLINE]Lest that thy love prove likewise variable.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_SHAKESPEARE_2_QUOTE: To be, or not to be? That is the question—[NEWLINE]Whether ’tis nobler in the mind to suffer[NEWLINE]The slings and arrows of outrageous fortune,[NEWLINE]Or to take arms against a sea of troubles,[NEWLINE]And, by opposing, end them?
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_SHELLEY_1_QUOTE: I beheld the wretch — the miserable monster whom I had created.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_SHELLEY_2_QUOTE: This intelligence brought us back from the prospect of paradise, held out after the lapse of an hundred thousand years, to the pain and misery at present existent upon earth.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_SUN_TZU_QUOTE: Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_TAGORE_1_QUOTE: I am willing to serve my country, but my worship I reserve for Right which is far greater than my country. To worship my country as a god is to bring a curse upon it.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_TAGORE_2_QUOTE: If some wanderer, leaving home, come here to watch the night and with bowed head listen to the murmur of the darkness, who is there to whisper the secrets of life into his ears if I, shutting my doors, should try to free myself from mortal bonds?
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_TITIAN_2_NAME: Salome with the Head of John the Baptist
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_TOLSTOY_1_QUOTE: “Pierre was right when he said that one must believe in the possibility of happiness in order to be happy, and I now believe in it. Let the dead bury the dead, but while I'm alive, I must live and be happy.”
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_TOLSTOY_2_QUOTE: All the girls in the world were divided into two classes: one class included all the girls in the world except her, and they had all the usual human feelings and were very ordinary girls; while the other class -herself alone- had no weaknesses and was superior to all humanity.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_TWAIN_1_QUOTE: "Jim said that bees won't sting idiots, but I didn't believe that, because I tried them lots of times myself and they wouldn't sting me.”
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_TWAIN_2_QUOTE: He had discovered a great law of human action, without knowing it--namely, that in order to make a man or a boy covet a thing, it is only necessary to make the thing difficult to attain.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_WELLS_1_QUOTE: No one would have believed in the last years of the nineteenth century that this world was being watched keenly and closely by intelligences greater than man's and yet as mortal as his own...
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_WELLS_2_QUOTE: Very simple was my explanation, and plausible enough - as many wrong theories are!
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_YING_1_NAME: Spring Morning in the Han Palace
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_YING_2_NAME: Fishermen in Reclusion Among the Lotus Stream

en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_BARBARIAN_CAMP_DESCRIPTI: Creates additional Barbarians.[ICON_Gold] Gold award if destroyed. -1 Appeal
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_BEACH_RESORT_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Seaside Resorts.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides [ICON_Tourism] Tourism equal to the tile's Appeal. Can only be built on Coastal Desert, Coastal Plains, or Coastal Grassland tiles. Minimum Appeal of Breathtaking.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_CAMP_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Camps.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Gold] Gold. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Luxury resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_CHATEAU_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Château, unique to France.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +1  [ICON_Gold] Gold. +1 Appeal. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture for every adjacent wonder (becomes +2 after researching Flight). +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold if on a tile containing a River edge. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism from [ICON_CULTURE] Culture after researching Flight. Must be placed adjacent to a Bonus or Luxury resource. Cannot be built adjacent to another Château.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_COLOSSAL_HEAD_DESCRIPTIO: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Colossal Head.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Faith] Faith. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 2 adjacent Rainforest. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 2 adjacent Woods. Cannot be built on Snow or Snow Hills.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FARM_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Farms.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Food] Food. Can only be built on Grassland or Plains.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Constructing farms adjacent to other Farms provides bonuses to Housing.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FISHING_BOATS_DESCRIPTIO: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Fishing Boats.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Food] Food. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Luxury resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_FORT_DESCRIPTION: Occupying unit receives +4 [ICON_Strength] Defense Strength, and automatically gains 2 turns of fortification.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_GREAT_WALL_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct the Great Wall, unique to China.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides an increase to [ICON_Strength] Defense. Bonus to [ICON_Gold] Gold if adjacent to other segments. Additional [ICON_Culture] Culture and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism as you advance through the Technology Tree for adjacent segments. Must be built in a line along the borders of your empire.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_KURGAN_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Kurgan, unique to Scythia.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith and +3 [ICON_Gold] Gold. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for each adjacent Pasture (becomes +2 after researching Stirrups). Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism from [ICON_FAITH] Faith after researching Flight. Cannot be built on Hills.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_LUMBER_MILL_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Lumber Mill.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Production] Production. +1 [ICON_Production] Production if adjacent to River. Can only be built on Woods.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MINE_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Mines.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Production] Production. -1 Appeal. Can be built on hills or valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Luxury or Strategic resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MISSILE_SILO_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Military Engineer ability to construct a Missile Silo.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Acts as a launch site for Nuclear and Thermonuclear Devices.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MISSION_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Mission, unique to Spain.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Faith] Faith. Additional +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science once Cultural Heritage is discovered. +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, and +1 [ICON_FOod] Food if on a different continent than your [ICON_Capital] Capital. +1 [ICON_Science] Science for every adjacent Campus and Holy Site district.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OFFSHORE_OIL_RIG_DESCRIP: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Offshore Oil Rig.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]-1 Appeal. Can only be built on Coast or Lake tiles with [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OIL_WELL_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Oil Well.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]-1 Appeal. Can only be built on land tiles with[ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_PASTURE_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Pastures.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Production] Production. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Strategic resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_PLANTATION_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Plantations.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] Gold. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Luxury resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_QUARRY_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Quarries.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Production] Production. -1 Appeal. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on a Luxury resource, the city will gain use of that resource.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_ROMAN_FORT_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Roman Legion ability to construct a Roman Fort, unique to Rome.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Occupying unit receives +4 [ICON_Strength] Defense Strength, and automatically gains 2 turns of fortification.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SPHINX_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Sphinx, unique to Egypt.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith and +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture. +1 Appeal. +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith if next to a wonder. Cannot be built next to another Sphinx. Can be built on Floodplains.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_STEPWELL_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Stepwell, unique to India.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Food] Food and +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith if adjacent to a Holy Site district. +1 [ICON_Food] Food if adjacent to a Farm. Additional [ICON_Housing] Housing, [ICON_Faith] Faith, and [ICON_Food] Food as you advance through the Technology and Civics Tree. Cannot be built on Hills or adjacent to another Stepwell.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_ZIGGURAT_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Ziggurat, unique to Sumeria.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Science] Science. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture if next to River. Cannot be built on Hills.

en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_BRUSSELS_DESCRIPTION: Your cities get +15% [ICON_Production] Production towards wonders.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_BUENOS_AIRES_DESCRIPTIO: Your Bonus resources behave like Luxury resources, providing 1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity per type.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_CARTHAGE_DESCRIPTION: Your Encampment districts provide +1 [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity each.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_GENEVA_DESCRIPTION: Your cities earn +15% [ICON_Science] Science whenever you are not at war with any civilization.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_HATTUSA_DESCRIPTION: Provides you with 1 of each Strategic resource you have revealed but do not own.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_HONG_KONG_DESCRIPTION: Your cities get +20% [ICON_Production] Production towards city projects.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_JAKARTA_DESCRIPTION: Your [ICON_TradingPost] Trading Posts in foreign cities provide +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold to your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes passing through or going to the city.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_JERUSALEM_DESCRIPTION: Automatically converts to the Religion you founded, and exerts pressure for that Religion as if it were a Holy City.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_KABUL_DESCRIPTION: Your units receive double experience from battles they initiate.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_KANDY_DESCRIPTION: Receive a [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relic every time you discover a new natural wonder, and earn +50% [ICON_Faith] Faith from all [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_KUMASI_DESCRIPTION: Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes to any city-state provide +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold for every specialty district in the origin city.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_LA_VENTA_DESCRIPTION: Your Builders can now make Colossal Head improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Colossal Heads provide +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 2 adjacent Rainforest. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 2 adjacent Woods. Cannot be built on Snow or Snow Hills.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_LISBON_DESCRIPTION: Your Trader units are immune to being plundered on water tiles.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_MOHENJO_DARO_DESCRIPTIO: Your cities have full [ICON_Housing] Housing from water, as if they were all next to a River.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_NAN_MADOL_DESCRIPTION: Your districts on or next to Coast or Lake tiles provide +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_PRESLAV_DESCRIPTION: Your light and heavy cavalry units have +5 [ICON_Strength] Strength when fighting on hill tiles.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_SEOUL_DESCRIPTION: When you enter a new era, earn 1 random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka from that era.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_STOCKHOLM_DESCRIPTION: Your districts provide +1 [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person point of their type ([ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer, [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist, and [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musician for Theater Square districts).
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_TORONTO_DESCRIPTION: Regional effects from your Industrial Zone and Entertainment Complex districts reach 3 tiles farther.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_VALLETTA_DESCRIPTION: City Center buildings and Encampment district buildings can be bought with [ICON_Faith] Faith. Cost of purchasing Ancient, Medieval, and Renaissance Walls is reduced, but they can only be bought with [ICON_Faith] Faith.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_VILNIUS_DESCRIPTION: When you enter a new era, earn 1 random [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration from that era.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_YEREVAN_DESCRIPTION: Your Apostle units can choose from any possible promotion instead of receiving a random promotion.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_ZANZIBAR_DESCRIPTION: Receive the [ICON_RESOURCE_CINNAMON] Cinnamon and [ICON_RESOURCE_CLOVES] Cloves Luxury resources. These cannot be earned any other way in the game, and provide 6 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities each.
en_US.LOC_LIMIT_TURNS_DESCRIPTION: Limit the maximum number of turns
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_BARBAROSSA: Heroic Frederick, king of the Germans, your task is to forge the independent states that surround you into an empire. You are blessed to be a great military leader – use those skills to bring these cities under your sway so they may develop into commercial and industrial powerhouses.  Surely then the bards will sing of mighty Frederick with the red beard, the great Holy Roman Emperor.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_CATHERINE_DE_MED: It falls to you, Catherine de Medici, to use your gifts of knowledge and of the arts to unite your people. Steer carefully through these troubled times, Queen Mother of France. You will build great wonders, drawing visitors from all corners of the earth. With your keen awareness of all things, both those seen and those hidden in the shadows, your empire will certainly stand the test of time.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_CLEOPATRA: There will be those who underestimate you, but you are cunning and full of tricks, Queen Cleopatra. Your charm will establish indestructible alliances with the strongest leaders of the world. Keep your friends close by your side and you will find yourself untouchable, with the glory of Egypt primed to win over the world.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_DEFAULT: It is up to you to lead your people to glory by building a civilization that will stand the test of time.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_GANDHI: Be kind, Gandhi Bapu, and you will find yourself surrounded by true friends. Keep the Indian people safe, guarding them with magnificent elephant warriors. Your faith will guide you to peace and harmony. Keep your mind open, and be the change you want to see in the world.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_GILGAMESH: Much rests upon your shoulders, King Gilgamesh. Your own people, and many people of the world, look to you as leader. But you are more than a mere man, and the weight of the world will never cause you to waver. Encourage the people of Sumer to settle the fertile lands along rivers, and be sure to choose your allies carefully - for there will be many vying for a piece of your strength. Venture forth, for it is time to begin your epic tale.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_GORGO: Gorgo, Queen of Sparta; glory to you and your loyal hoplite armies! Greece savors the blessings from Ares that every victory brings. And your people applaud your thoughtful governance and cultural marvels. Stand proud, for the legacy of Greece, and of your achievements, will be told over and over again for generations.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_HARDRADA: All men fear the approach of your ships, King Harald of Norway, Thunderbolt of the North. Your longboats dominate the waves, always at the ready to unleash their berserker armies on an unsuspecting shore.  May Odin bless your kingdom and may the skalds sing tales of the victories of your mighty warriors.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_HOJO: The great wave of Buddhism follows you, Shikken of Japan, Hojo Tokimune. Your people truly understand what it is to practice balance, and even your finest samurai will be well-learned and spiritually apt. Be strong, embrace the divine wind, and you will reach enlightenment.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_MONTEZUMA: Tlatoani Montezuma, keep your eagle warriors happy and fed, and they will forever fight for your cause. As your Aztec empire unfurls across the land, you will never want for people to raise your walls, for you will be blessed with new, loyal workers as you conquer those around you. Go forth; Huitzilopochtli calls.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_MVEMBA: Mother Earth has many gifts for you, King Mvemba a Nzinga. Your people know the dense woods and rainforests as their homes, and glide through them with ease.  Great also are the gifts that come from travelers of distant lands. Keep an open mind, for the inspiration of the open world will let our people create art with power and majesty.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_PEDRO: Your people look to you, Emperor Pedro II, to lead Brazil onto the world stage. Use your reputation as a patron of artists, scientists, and engineers to draw the greatest minds to our fertile home. For it is in the lush rainforests, teeming with life, that your people thrive. Watch them in the Carnival as they dance the samba in celebration of your great feats, Pedro the Magnanimous.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_PERICLES: Your mastery of the spoken word is a gift of great value, silver-tongued Pericles, leader of the Greeks. Through it you can attract the devotion of a league of states, surrounding yourself with their glory. Establish cultural sites along the rocky shores of Greece to unite your people behind your strong governance.  If all goes well the Sirens will sing of the Age of Pericles!
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_PETER_GREAT: Embrace the chill winds of the Motherland, Tsar Peter. Your fascination with science and culture is a gift, and you will learn much from your Grand Embassies to foreign lands. Under your rule, Russia will surely flourish and spread, absorbing all that lies around it, perhaps creating the greatest land empire seen on this earth.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_PHILIP_II: All Spain stands ready to answer your prayers, devout King Philip II.  From your palace at El Escorial you can send forth your followers: missionaries, apostles, and conquistadors ready to strike out across the seas to spread the good word about your most holy empire.  May the treasures they uncover fuel your quest to unite the world under one faith and one empire, making you truly the Most Catholic king.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_QIN: In your people lies your greatest strength, Emperor Qin Shi Huang. From all over the world, others will come to gaze upon the great walls and towering wonders of your united China. May the hands of your men never blister as they work hard and fast to raise the most impressive structures that the world will ever know. Protect them well, and you will forever be immortalized.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_SALADIN: The marriage of science and religion is a delicate balancing act, but one that you have mastered, Saladin. Your quest for knowledge is noble, and your people have a deep respect for you. But you need not rush into the unknown. Given time, the answers to life’s most puzzling questions will find their way back to Arabia.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_TOMYRIS: All people will tremble with fear and respect for you, great warrior Queen Tomyris. For it is from the back of your stallion that you shall look upon and lead the Scythian people. Great epics will be told of the horse warriors that ride forth from the steppe, and at the front line of every battle - they will find you. Ride on, fierce queen, and may your friends be true just as your enemies falter.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_TRAJAN: Cast your net wide, oh Trajan, emperor of mighty Rome. Your legions stand at the ready to march out and establish the largest empire the world has ever seen. If you can truly get all roads to lead to Rome, yours will be an empire of great riches and luxuries.  Surely then our citizens will proclaim you as their best ruler, the Optimus Princeps.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_T_ROOSEVELT: And so it is upon your broad shoulders, Theodore Roosevelt, to charge forth and lead your people on their great adventure. Use your military might to give the peoples of your homeland the square deal they so desperately deserve. Surely you will raise America into the limelight and attract visitors from across the oceans just to see your lands. Bully for you, Mr. President.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_VICTORIA: Your Majesty the Queen Victoria of England, extend your reach beyond your borders and across the face of the globe.  Worry not over the possibility of defeat for your loyal redcoats and overwhelming navy will surely carry the day. With your calm and steady touch you can bring all lands under England's sway, establishing a true Pax Britannica.
