en_US.LOC_UNIT_AIRCRAFT_CARRIER_DESCRIPTION: Atomic era melee naval unit that can transport air units.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_AMERICAN_P51_DESCRIPTION: American unique Atomic era air unit that replaces the Fighter.  Gains +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength against fighter aircraft, has +2 flight range, and gains +50% experience.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_AMERICAN_ROUGH_RIDER_DESCRIPTIO: American unique Industrial era unit when Teddy Roosevelt is their leader. [ICON_Culture] Culture is earned from kills on their [ICON_Capital] Capital's continent. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting on Hills. Lower maintenance cost.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ANTIAIR_GUN_DESCRIPTION: Atomic era anti-air support unit. Provides cover from air attacks up to 1 hex away from the weapon.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_APOSTLE_DESCRIPTION: May convert [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to their Religion and initiate theological combat with units of other Religions. Once per game may Launch Inquisition to allow the purchase of Inquisitors. Once per game may Evangelize Belief to add an additional Belief to their Religion. These uses consume the Apostle.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ARABIAN_MAMLUK_DESCRIPTION: Arabian unique Medieval era unit that replaces the Knight. Heals at the end of every turn, even after moving or attacking.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ARCHAEOLOGIST_DESCRIPTION: Find and extract [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts from [ICON_RESOURCE_ANTIQUITY_SITE] Antiquity Sites to be displayed in their home city's Museum.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ARCHER_DESCRIPTION: First Ancient era ranged unit with a [ICON_Range] Range of 2.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ARTILLERY_DESCRIPTION: Modern era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_AT_CREW_DESCRIPTION: Modern era counter to cavalry class units.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_AZTEC_EAGLE_WARRIOR_DESCRIPTION: Aztec unique Ancient era unit that replaces the Warrior.  Has a chance to capture other civilization's military units by turning them into Builders.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_BATTERING_RAM_DESCRIPTION: Ancient era support unit. When adjacent to a city, attacking melee units do full damage to the city's Walls.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_BATTLESHIP_DESCRIPTION: Modern era naval ranged unit. Provides cover from air and nuclear attacks up to 1 tile away.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_BIPLANE_DESCRIPTION: First air combat unit, available in the Modern era.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_BOMBARD_DESCRIPTION: Renaissance era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_BOMBER_DESCRIPTION: First bomber unit, available in the Atomic era.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_BRAZILIAN_MINAS_GERAES_DESCRIPT: Brazilian unique Industrial era unit that replaces the Battleship. Stronger than the Battleship. Unlocked by Nationalism.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_BUILDER_DESCRIPTION: May create tile improvements, remove features like Woods or Rainforest, or Harvest some resources. Builders can be used 3 times. This can be increased through policies or wonders like the Pyramids.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_CAPTURED: Allowing such a vulnerable unit to remain unprotected was not a wise choice.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Your unit has been captured by {1_Civ}.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_CARAVEL_DESCRIPTION: Fast Renaissance era exploration melee naval unit.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_CATAPULT_DESCRIPTION: Classical era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_CAVALRY_DESCRIPTION: Fast-moving Industrial era light cavalry unit.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_CHINESE_CROUCHING_TIGER_DESCRIP: Chinese unique Medieval era unit. Ranged unit with a [ICON_Range] Range of 1 and high combat strength.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_DESTROYER_DESCRIPTION: Strongest melee naval unit. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_EGYPTIAN_CHARIOT_ARCHER_DESCRIP: Egyptian unique Ancient era ranged unit that replaces the Heavy Chariot. 4 [ICON_Movement] Movement when starting in open terrain.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ENGLISH_REDCOAT_DESCRIPTION: English unique Industrial era unit when Victoria is their leader that replaces the Line Infantry. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting on a continent other than that of your capital's. No disembark cost.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ENGLISH_SEADOG_DESCRIPTION: English unique Renaissance era naval unit that replaces the Privateer. Has a chance to capture defeated enemy ships. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_FRENCH_GARDE_IMPERIALE_DESCRIPT: French unique Industrial era melee unit that replaces the Line Infantry. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting on your capital's continent. [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great General points for killing units.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GALLEY_DESCRIPTION: Ancient era melee naval combat unit. Can only operate on Coastal waters until Cartography is researched.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GERMAN_UBOAT_DESCRIPTION: German unique Modern era naval unit that replaces the Submarine. Cheaper to produce, +1 Sight, and +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting on Ocean tiles. Able to reveal other stealthed units.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ADMIRAL_DESCRIPTION: Each [ICON_GreatAdmiral] Great Admiral has unique abilities, including a passive effect, and a Retire effect. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ARTIST_DESCRIPTION: Each [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist generates a [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] Great Work of Art when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ENGINEER_DESCRIPTION: Each [ICON_GreatEngineer] Great Engineer has unique abilities when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_GENERAL_DESCRIPTION: Each [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great General has unique abilities, including a passive effect, and a Retire effect. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_MERCHANT_DESCRIPTION: Each [ICON_GreatMerchant] Great Merchant has unique abilities when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_MUSICIAN_DESCRIPTION: Each [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musician generates a [ICON_GreatWork_Music] Great Work of Music when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_PROPHET_DESCRIPTION: Great [ICON_GreatProphet] Prophets can found a Religion when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_SCIENTIST_DESCRIPTION: Each [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist has unique abilities when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GREAT_WRITER_DESCRIPTION: Each [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer generates a [ICON_GreatWork_Writing] Great Work of Writing when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GREEK_HOPLITE_DESCRIPTION: Greek unique Ancient era anti-cavalry unit that replaces the Spearman. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength if there is at least one adjacent Hoplite unit.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GURU_DESCRIPTION: May use a charge to heal itself and all adjacent friendly religious units. May not initiate theological combat with units of other Religions (but can defend).
en_US.LOC_UNIT_HEAVY_CHARIOT_DESCRIPTION: Hard-hitting, Ancient era heavy cavalry unit. Gains 1 bonus [ICON_Movement] Movement if it begins a turn on a flat tile with no Woods, Rainforest, or Hills.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_HELICOPTER_DESCRIPTION: Fast-moving Atomic era light cavalry unit.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_HORSEMAN_DESCRIPTION: Fast-moving Classical era light cavalry unit.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_INDIAN_VARU_DESCRIPTION: Indian unique Classical era heavy cavalry unit.  Adjacent enemy units receive -5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_INQUISITOR_DESCRIPTION: May eliminate the presence of other Religions in their territory, and initiate theological combat with units of other Religions.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_IRONCLAD_DESCRIPTION: Powerful Industrial era armored melee naval unit.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_JAPANESE_SAMURAI_DESCRIPTION: Japanese unique Medieval era melee unit that replaces the Man-At-Arms. Does not suffer combat penalties when damaged.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION: Hard-hitting, Medieval era heavy cavalry unit.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_KONGO_SHIELD_BEARER_DESCRIPTION: Kongo unique Classical era unit that replaces the Swordsman. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when defending against ranged attacks. Can move and see through Woods and Rainforest.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MEDIC_DESCRIPTION: Industrial era support unit. Can heal adjacent units.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MILITARY_ENGINEER_DESCRIPTION: Medieval era support unit. Requires an Armory to produce. Can construct Roads, Forts, Airstrips, and Missile Silo improvements.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MISSILE_CRUISER_DESCRIPTION: Strongest ranged naval unit, available in the Information era.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MISSIONARY_DESCRIPTION: May convert [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to their Religion. May not initiate theological combat with units of other Religions (but can defend).
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MOBILE_SAM_DESCRIPTION: Information era anti-air support unit. Provides cover from air and nuclear attacks up to 1 hex away from the weapon.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MODERN_ARMOR_DESCRIPTION: Information era heavy cavalry unit that is fast and strong.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MODERN_AT_DESCRIPTION: Information era counter to cavalry class units.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_NATURALIST_DESCRIPTION: A late-game civilian who can create a single National Park to attract [ICON_Tourism] Tourists. Must be purchased with [ICON_Faith] Faith.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_NORWEGIAN_BERSERKER_DESCRIPTION: Norwegian unique Medieval era melee unit that replaces the Man-At-Arms. 4 [ICON_Movement] Movement if this unit starts in enemy territory. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when attacking and -5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when defending against melee attacks.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_NORWEGIAN_LONGSHIP_DESCRIPTION: Norwegian unique Ancient era naval unit that replaces the Galley. Can pillage enemy coastal lands and capture civilians if adjacent using its coastal raiding ability. 4 [ICON_Movement] Movement while in coastal waters.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_NUCLEAR_SUBMARINE_DESCRIPTION: Highly advanced Information era ranged raiding naval unit that can be armed with nuclear weapons. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_OBSERVATION_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION: Modern era support unit. Grants +1 [ICON_Range] Range to Siege class units within 1 hex.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_PRIVATEER_DESCRIPTION: Renaissance era ranged naval unit with the ability to coastal raid.Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_QUADRIREME_DESCRIPTION: Classical era ranged naval unit. Can only operate on Coastal waters until Cartography is researched.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ROCKET_ARTILLERY_DESCRIPTION: Information era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ROMAN_LEGION_DESCRIPTION: Roman unique Classical era melee unit that replaces the Swordsman. Can build a Roman Fort.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_RUSSIAN_COSSACK_DESCRIPTION: Russian unique Industrial era unit that replaces Cavalry. Stronger than Cavalry, and gains +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting in or adjacent to its home territory. Can move after attacking if [ICON_Movement] Movement points remain.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SCYTHIAN_HORSE_ARCHER_DESCRIPTI: Scythian unique Classical era unit. Ranged unit with 4 [ICON_Movement] Movement with a [ICON_Range] Range of 1.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SETTLER_DESCRIPTION: May create new cities. Reduces city's [ICON_Citizen] Population by 1 when completed.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SIEGE_TOWER_DESCRIPTION: Classical era support unit. When adjacent to a city, attacking melee units ignore Walls and immediately assault the city.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SLINGER_DESCRIPTION: Weak Ancient era ranged unit. Better on attack than defense.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SPANISH_CONQUISTADOR_DESCRIPTIO: Spanish unique Renaissance era unit that replaces the Musketman. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when there is a religious unit within one hex. If this unit captures a city or is adjacent to a city when it is captured, the city will automatically adopt the Conquistador player's Religion as the dominant Religion.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SPY_DESCRIPTION: Performs secret missions in foreign cities and protects your cities from enemy Spies.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SUBMARINE_DESCRIPTION: Modern era ranged raiding naval unit. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SUMERIAN_WAR_CART_DESCRIPTION: Sumerian unique Ancient era unit. Stronger than all other starting units. No penalties against anti-cavalry units. 4 [ICON_Movement] Movement if this unit starts in open terrain.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TANK_DESCRIPTION: Fast-moving Modern era heavy cavalry unit that ignores zone of control.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRADER_DESCRIPTION: May make and maintain a single [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route. Automatically creates Roads as it travels.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_FULL_TRADE_ROUTE_CAPACITY: Your Civilization needs more [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_NEED_MILITARY_ACADEMY: Corps and Armies require a Military Academy to build outright.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_NO_EMPTY_AIR_SLOTS: This city is at full capacity for aircraft.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICTS_CONTAM: The districts required to train this unit are contaminated.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICTS_DESTRO: The districts required to train this unit are damaged.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICTS_OCCUPI: The districts required to train this unit are occupied by enemy units.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICT_CONTAMI: The district required to train this unit is contaminated.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICT_DESTROY: The district required to train this unit is damaged.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRED_DISTRICT_OCCUPIE: The district required to train this unit is occupied by an enemy unit.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRES_POPULATION: This city needs at least {1_PopulationNeeded} [ICON_Citizen] Population.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRES_RESOURCE_ACCESS: Your civilization needs {2_AmountNeededWithoutDistrict} {5_ResourceIcon} {1_ResourceName} to train this type of unit. If this city has a {4_DistrictName}, you only need {3_AmountNeededWithDistrict} {5_ResourceIcon} {1_ResourceName}.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRAIN_REQUIRES_RESOURCE_SUPPLY: Not enough {1_Resource} supply is available. Each unit alive or in production uses 1 supply, and each Owned or Imported resource in any city provides 4 supply.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TREBUCHET_DESCRIPTION: Medieval era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_WARRIOR_MONK_DESCRIPTION: Fast-moving land combat unit with a unique promotion tree.

en_US.LOC_VICTORY_CULTURE_TEXT: The worth of a culture is not measured by its accomplishments, but in how those accomplishments last, and how they are remembered. The beauty that you have inspired our people to create will ensure that our culture stands for all time.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_CULTURE_TT: Your cultural greatness will attract all of the world's people to your empire. This is the most difficult victory to achieve.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_DEFAULT_TEXT: Everyone else has lost... Therefore you've won!
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_DOMINATION_TEXT: Though its face may change throughout the ages, history is written from the hand of the victor. By your actions this day, you ensure our people are glorious tomorrow.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_DOMINATION_TT: Through military strength and prowess, you bring the world to its knees. This is the most basic victory to achieve.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_RELIGION_TEXT: We have a basic need to believe in something greater than ourselves. We crave solace in the darkness, a light unto our path. Thanks to you, we’ve found meaning amid the Cosmos.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_RELIGIOUS_TT: Spread your religion to the four corners of the Earth, bringing light to a dark World. You will have to master diplomatic relationships if you hope to convert the world to the one true religion.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_SCIENCE_TEXT: Much as our ancestors did ages ago, we thrust forward into the unknown. The first pioneers set forth on an uneasy course, and yet once again our people thrive.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_SCIENCE_TT: Be the first to colonize Mars to win a Science victory. This victory is straight-forward, but can be difficult to achieve before time runs out.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_SCORE_TEXT: From our humble beginnings ages ago have you forged a civilization that has withstood time itself. Though countless civilizations rise and fall around us, we do not just survive. We prosper.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_SCORE_TT: While you were not able to achieve a grand victory, you'll take what you can get. This victory is triggered when time runs out, and there are no other victors.
en_US.LOC_VIZSOURCE_ACTION_DELEGATE: Send a delegation or establish an embassy.
en_US.LOC_VIZSOURCE_ACTION_GREAT_PERSON_JOURNA: Use Mary Katherine Goddard's Great Merchant ability.
en_US.LOC_VIZSOURCE_ACTION_SPY: Send a Spy on a Listening Post mission.
en_US.LOC_VIZSOURCE_GREAT_PERSON_JOURNALISM: Mary Katherine Goddard's Great Merchant effect
en_US.LOC_WAITING_FOR_PLAYERS_COUNTDOWN_TT: Waiting for additional players. Game will start at the end of the countdown or once the game is full of ready players.
en_US.LOC_WAITING_ON_YOU_BANNER: The game is waiting on you!
en_US.LOC_WARMACHINE_SCENARIO_DESCRIPTION: In this scenario you take command of the armies of France or Germany during the first month of WWI. You have a massive army poised to strike, an industrial nation ready to back it up, and only 40 turns to capture or defend Paris. Can you triumph in the greatest clash of arms the world has ever seen? Or will warfare on this scale and speed overwhelm you?
en_US.LOC_WARMACHINE_SCENARIO_TOOLTIP: 1v1 multiplayer scenario based on the German attack on France during the outbreak of WWI.

en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_CULTURAL_VICTORY_TURN: This player will achieve a Cultural Victory in {1_Turns : plural 1?{1_Turns} turn; other?{1_Turns} turns;}.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_CULTURE_DETAILS_DOMES: Your [COLOR:ResCultureLabelCS]DOMESTIC TOURISTS[ENDCOLOR] represent the tourists from your civilization that are currently happy vacationing within your borders.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_CULTURE_DETAILS_VISIT: Your [COLOR:ResCultureLabelCS]VISITING TOURISTS[ENDCOLOR] represent the number of citizens you've attracted from the [COLOR:ResCultureLabelCS]DOMESTIC TOURIST[ENDCOLOR] pools of other civilizations.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_CULTURE_DOMESTIC_TOUR: This column indicates how many of this civilization's tourists are still vacationing within their own borders.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_CULTURE_HOW_TO_ATTRAC: How to attract Tourists to your civilization.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_CULTURE_HOW_TO_TOURIS: How to attract Tourists to your civilization.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_CULTURE_OUR_VISITORS_: This column shows how many tourists from this civilization are currently visiting us.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_CULTURE_TOURISM_DETAI: Your ability to attract [COLOR:ResCultureLabelCS]VISITING TOURISTS[ENDCOLOR] to your civilization is a function of the difference between your own [ICON_Culture] Culture production, and that of the civilization whose [COLOR:ResCultureLabelCS]DOMESTIC TOURIST[ENDCOLOR] you are attempting to attract.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_CULTURE_VICTORY_DETAI: To achieve a [COLOR:ResCultureLabelCS]CULTURE[ENDCOLOR] victory, you must become [COLOR:ResCultureLabelCS]CULTURALLY DOMINANT[ENDCOLOR] over all other civilizations. Cultural dominance occurs when you attract more [COLOR:ResCultureLabelCS]VISITING TOURISTS[ENDCOLOR] to your civilization than the other civilization has [COLOR:ResCultureLabelCS]DOMESTIC TOURISTS[ENDCOLOR] at home.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Generating high amounts of [ICON_Culture] Culture and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism increases both your domestic tourists and visiting tourists from other civilizations.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_CULTURE_VISITING_TOUR: This column shows the total number of visiting tourists attracted to our civ out of the current total we need to achieve a Culture Victory.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_DOMINATION_DETAILS: To achieve a [COLOR:ResMilitaryLabelCS]DOMINATION[ENDCOLOR] victory, you must conquer the original [ICON_Capital] Capital of every other civilization.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A strong military is highly recommended.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_OVERVIEW_CULTURE_NUM_: {1_Num} {1_Num : plural 1?civilization is; other?civilizations are;} culturally dominant over us.
We are culturally dominant over {1_Num} {1_Num : plural 1?civilization; other?civilizations;}
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_OVERVIEW_CULTURE_THEY: This civilization is culturally dominant over us
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_OVERVIEW_CULTURE_WE_A: We are culturally dominant over this civilization
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_RELIGION_DETAILS: To achieve a [COLOR:ResFaithLabelCS]RELIGIOUS[ENDCOLOR] victory, your Religion must become the [COLOR:ResFaithLabelCS]PREDOMINANT[ENDCOLOR] Religion for every civilization in the game.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A Religion is [COLOR:ResFaithLabelCS]PREDOMINANT[ENDCOLOR] if it is followed by more than 50% of the cities in a civilization.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_SCIENCE_DETAILS: To achieve a [COLOR:ResScienceLabelCS]SCIENCE[ENDCOLOR] victory, you must accomplish 3 major milestones:
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_SCIENCE_REQUIREMENT_2: Land a human on the Moon.
en_US.LOC_WORLD_RANKINGS_SCORE_DETAILS: A [COLOR:NeutralCS]SCORE[ENDCOLOR] victory occurs when no civilization has achieved any other victory by the end of the game. In this case, the civilization with the overall highest [COLOR:NeutralCS]SCORE[ENDCOLOR] will win!
